protocol.design: Four matched project pairs with varied policy constants; nine fresh conversations per arm. Arms start concurrently in alternating order, two concurrent isolated-worktree workers per arm. No session resume or evaluator feedback.
protocol.baseline: Ordinary Markdown notes/plans/handoffs allowed. No DIP config, hooks, MCP, daemon, shell profile or native Git trace.
protocol.treatment: Same instructions plus DIP 0.3.4 generated project instructions, trusted real hooks and approved MCP tools. Private shared runtime across worktrees; no resident daemon.
protocol.interrupt: Terminate the receipt worker process tree 2000ms after the first receipt.mjs content mutation (100ms polling). If no mutation occurs within 180000ms retain that timeout. No forced handoff; retain partial files and raw transcript.
protocol.integration: Harness commits each stage in fixture-only Git. Parallel workers fork the same commit. Merge both worker branches in alternating order; stop if conflicted and leave actual Git merge state plus factual MERGE_HANDOFF.md for the fresh integrator. Integrator may resolve/commit/merge remaining branches. No scorer output is exposed.
protocol.primary: Final held-out functional correctness: 30 deterministic cases per project. Project-level all-case success is primary; case totals are clustered descriptive results.
protocol.secondary: Ten exact current-policy fields plus two deferred identifiers and one cancellation; release-ready false positives, unsupported component completion claims, final scope reporting, actual merge conflicts, read-only audit compliance, interruption recovery and intermediate stage snapshots. Tokens/time are secondary and interrupted turns can lack usage.
protocol.policy: All four pairs and all scheduled stages retained, no result-dependent retries or prompt edits. Infrastructure-only preflight excluded and retained separately. No product optimization during experiment.
protocol.limits: Synthetic repeated order-processing domain, n=4 project pairs, accelerated multi-session lifecycle rather than days of real development. Same model ID/effort, no fixed weights/random seed. Directory/config boundaries are instructions, not OS containment. Worktrees protect files in both arms; DIP coordination is local-machine shared-runtime coordination, not distributed locking. Hook-trust bypass applies only to generated reviewed test hooks.
protocol.instructions: Work only in this repository/worktree. Do not read sibling worktrees, user settings, credentials, previous conversations or the evaluator. No network, dependency installation, extra agents or machine settings. Use Node.js built-ins and PowerShell without profiles. Ordinary Markdown plans, decisions and handoff notes are allowed. Keep future features deferred and cancelled features cancelled. Report actual code state, not just a plan. Do not commit or create branches yourself unless the integration prompt explicitly permits resolving an existing merge. Repository state is the only memory between these fresh conversations.

prompts.seed:
Create a plan for this project and start it. Build a local order-processing library with these exports in the indicated modules. normalizeCart(cart) in cart.mjs: accept an array of lines; keep lines whose sku is a nonempty trimmed string, quantity is a positive integer, and unitPriceCents is a nonnegative integer. Trim sku; drop invalid lines, including null. Combine quantities only for the same trimmed sku AND unit price, preserving first appearance. Return new {sku,quantity,unitPriceCents} objects, without modifying input. priceOrder(cart, options={}) in cart.mjs returns exactly {subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}. subtotal is sum of normalized quantity*price. couponPercent defaults to 0; clamp it to [0,cap]. Round discount once with Math.round(subtotal*couponPercent/100). Round tax once with Math.round(taxBase*taxRate/100). shippingCents defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping. buildReceipt(order) in receipt.mjs uses order={id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}; return exactly {orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount:sum of normalized quantities,currency}. renderCSV(receipts) in receipt.mjs returns a header orderId,totalCents,currency followed by rows; escape fields containing comma, quote or newline using CSV quoting and doubled quotes; no trailing newline; empty input returns just the header. reserveInventory(stock,cart) in inventory.mjs: stock is an object of nonnegative integer counts by sku, absent sku means 0; aggregate normalized quantities across prices, check ALL availability first; throw RangeError('insufficient stock') if any sku is insufficient; otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart, even on failure. canReturn(order,{nowDay}) in returns.mjs returns exactly {eligible,reason}. Check in order: status must equal 'delivered' else reason 'status'; deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers with nowDay>=deliveredDay else reason 'date'; nowDay-deliveredDay must be <= returnWindowDays else reason 'window'; otherwise {eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}. fulfillOrder(order,stock) in pipeline.mjs returns exactly {receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}. returnOrder(order,context) in pipeline.mjs returns exactly {...canReturn(order,context),refundCents:eligible?priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents:0,currency}. formatSummary(receipts) in summary.mjs returns exactly {orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sum of totalCents,units:sum of itemCount}. No input mutation anywhere. MULTI_CURRENCY and LOYALTY_POINTS are separate FUTURE ideas, not part of this release.

# Local order-processing library

## Scope and handoff

Build a local JavaScript ES module library using Node.js built-ins only. No input
mutation anywhere. Return exactly the requested fields. All nine current release
exports are implemented and integrated. The earlier summary side task is complete;
integration now includes receipt/CSV, inventory, eligibility and both pipelines.
MULTI_CURRENCY and FRAUD_SCORING are FUTURE ideas, deferred outside this release.
LOYALTY_POINTS is CANCELLED entirely and is not a future commitment.

## Release policy

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 7,
  "couponCapPercent": 20,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 14,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

This revised policy supersedes the earlier tax rate, coupon cap, subtotal tax
base, and return window. All adapters use this policy and the shared
`priceOrder` calculation below.

## Implementation sequence and contracts

1. **Implemented:** `normalizeCart(cart)` in `cart.mjs`.
   Accept an array of lines. Keep only lines with a nonempty trimmed string SKU,
   positive integer quantity, and nonnegative integer unit price in cents.
   Drop invalid lines, including null. Trim SKU and merge quantities only for
   identical trimmed SKU AND price, preserving first appearance of each pair.
   Return new `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}` objects without mutating input.
   Uses nested Maps to distinguish prices and handle arbitrary SKU strings.

2. **Implemented:** `priceOrder(cart, options={})` in `cart.mjs`.
   Return exactly `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`.
   Subtotal is the sum of normalized quantity times unit price. Coupon percent
   (`options.couponPercent`) defaults to 0 and is clamped to [0,20]. Discount is rounded once using
   `Math.round(subtotalCents * couponPercent / 100)`. Tax is rounded once using
   `Math.round((subtotalCents - discountCents) * 7 / 100)`: tax is AFTER the
   rounded order discount and excludes shipping. Shipping (`options.shippingCents`)
   defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax
   plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.
   Preserve the revised tax base and once-per-order rounding.

3. **Implemented:** `buildReceipt(order)` and `renderCSV(receipts)` in `receipt.mjs`.
   Order shape: `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}`. Receipt is exactly
   `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`,
   with itemCount the sum of normalized quantities and currency `USD`.
   CSV header is `orderId,totalCents,currency`; rows use these fields in order.
   Quote fields containing comma, double quote, or newline and double embedded
   quotes. Separate records using LF, with no trailing newline. Empty input
   returns only the header.

4. **Implemented:** `reserveInventory(stock,cart)` in `inventory.mjs`.
   Stock is an object of nonnegative integer counts keyed by SKU; absent SKU
   means 0. Aggregate normalized quantities across prices. Check ALL availability
   first; if any SKU is insufficient, throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')`.
   Otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Preserve stock
   and cart on both success and failure.

5. **Implemented:** `canReturn(order,{nowDay})` in `returns.mjs`.
   Return exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Check in this order: status must be
   `delivered`, else `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`; deliveredDay and nowDay
   must be nonnegative integers with nowDay >= deliveredDay, else reason `date`;
   elapsed days must be <= 14 (inclusive), else reason `window`; otherwise return
   `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

6. **Implemented:** `fulfillOrder(order,stock)` and `returnOrder(order,context)` in
   `pipeline.mjs`. Preserve the other pipeline export when adding either one.
   Fulfillment returns exactly
   `{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.
   Return processing returns exactly
   `{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents,currency}` where refundCents is
   `priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` if eligible and 0 otherwise,
   and currency is `USD`.

7. **Implemented:** `formatSummary(receipts)` in `summary.mjs`.
   Return exactly `{orders:receipts.length,totalCents,units}` where totalCents is
   the sum of receipt totalCents and units the sum of receipt itemCount.

## Verification and current code state

All release modules export their contracted functions. The interrupted receipt
checkpoint already contained complete `buildReceipt` and `renderCSV` code and
eight receipt/CSV tests; integration verified that code against the current
policy and corrected its stale pending status. Worker A supplied reservation
and fulfillment, and Worker B supplied eligibility and return processing.
The shared pipeline conflict was resolved by retaining both exports and all
four imports; neither worker's functionality was discarded.

Tests cover normalization, exact fields, revised pricing, rounding, receipt
counts, CSV escaping and LF separators, atomic shortages, special SKU keys,
return precedence and day boundaries, and input preservation. `release.test.mjs`
exercises all nine exports together and persists the previously manual summary
checks for empty input, zero totals, aggregation, and frozen inputs.

Run `node --test` from the repository root. No dependencies are needed.
Verified during integration on 2026-10-06: all 40 tests passed with no failures,
skips or pending tests; `git diff --check` and `git diff --cached --check` passed.
`handoff.json` records the ten current policy fields, all nine implemented
exports, deferred/cancelled identifiers and no unresolved release requirements.
MULTI_CURRENCY and FRAUD_SCORING remain deferred; LOYALTY_POINTS stays cancelled.

# Local order-processing library

## Scope and handoff

Build a local JavaScript ES module library using Node.js built-ins only. No input
mutation anywhere. Return exactly the requested fields. All nine current release
exports are implemented and integrated. The earlier summary side task is complete;
integration now includes receipt/CSV, inventory, eligibility and both pipelines.
MULTI_CURRENCY and FRAUD_SCORING are FUTURE ideas, deferred outside this release.
LOYALTY_POINTS is CANCELLED entirely and is not a future commitment.

## Release policy

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 7,
  "couponCapPercent": 20,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "EUR",
  "csvNewline": "CRLF",
  "returnWindowDays": 16,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

The final release request supersedes currency, CSV record separators and the
return window with EUR, CRLF without a trailing newline, and 16 elapsed days
inclusive. The revised tax rate, coupon cap, discounted tax base and all other
requirements remain in force. All adapters use this policy and the shared
`priceOrder` calculation below.

## Implementation sequence and contracts

1. **Implemented:** `normalizeCart(cart)` in `cart.mjs`.
   Accept an array of lines. Keep only lines with a nonempty trimmed string SKU,
   positive integer quantity, and nonnegative integer unit price in cents.
   Drop invalid lines, including null. Trim SKU and merge quantities only for
   identical trimmed SKU AND price, preserving first appearance of each pair.
   Return new `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}` objects without mutating input.
   Uses nested Maps to distinguish prices and handle arbitrary SKU strings.

2. **Implemented:** `priceOrder(cart, options={})` in `cart.mjs`.
   Return exactly `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`.
   Subtotal is the sum of normalized quantity times unit price. Coupon percent
   (`options.couponPercent`) defaults to 0 and is clamped to [0,20]. Discount is rounded once using
   `Math.round(subtotalCents * couponPercent / 100)`. Tax is rounded once using
   `Math.round((subtotalCents - discountCents) * 7 / 100)`: tax is AFTER the
   rounded order discount and excludes shipping. Shipping (`options.shippingCents`)
   defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax
   plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.
   Preserve the revised tax base and once-per-order rounding.

3. **Implemented:** `buildReceipt(order)` and `renderCSV(receipts)` in `receipt.mjs`.
   Order shape: `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}`. Receipt is exactly
   `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`,
   with itemCount the sum of normalized quantities and currency `EUR`.
   CSV header is `orderId,totalCents,currency`; rows use these fields in order.
   Quote fields containing comma, double quote, or newline and double embedded
   quotes. Separate records using CRLF, with no trailing newline. Preserve
   embedded field line endings inside quotes. Empty input returns only the header.

4. **Implemented:** `reserveInventory(stock,cart)` in `inventory.mjs`.
   Stock is an object of nonnegative integer counts keyed by SKU; absent SKU
   means 0. Aggregate normalized quantities across prices. Check ALL availability
   first; if any SKU is insufficient, throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')`.
   Otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Preserve stock
   and cart on both success and failure.

5. **Implemented:** `canReturn(order,{nowDay})` in `returns.mjs`.
   Return exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Check in this order: status must be
   `delivered`, else `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`; deliveredDay and nowDay
   must be nonnegative integers with nowDay >= deliveredDay, else reason `date`;
   elapsed days must be <= 16 (inclusive), else reason `window`; otherwise return
   `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

6. **Implemented:** `fulfillOrder(order,stock)` and `returnOrder(order,context)` in
   `pipeline.mjs`. Preserve the other pipeline export when adding either one.
   Fulfillment returns exactly
   `{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.
   Return processing returns exactly
   `{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents,currency}` where refundCents is
   `priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` if eligible and 0 otherwise,
   and currency is `EUR` for both eligible and rejected returns.

7. **Implemented:** `formatSummary(receipts)` in `summary.mjs`.
   Return exactly `{orders:receipts.length,totalCents,units}` where totalCents is
   the sum of receipt totalCents and units the sum of receipt itemCount.

## Verification and current code state

All release modules export their contracted functions. The interrupted receipt
checkpoint already contained complete `buildReceipt` and `renderCSV` code and
eight receipt/CSV tests; integration verified that code against the current
policy and corrected its stale pending status. Worker A supplied reservation
and fulfillment, and Worker B supplied eligibility and return processing.
The shared pipeline conflict was resolved by retaining both exports and all
four imports; neither worker's functionality was discarded.

Tests cover normalization, exact fields, revised pricing, rounding, receipt
counts, CSV escaping, CRLF separators with no trailing newline, atomic shortages,
special SKU keys, return precedence and day boundaries, and input preservation.
Eligibility and refund tests explicitly accept days 14, 15 and 16 and reject day
17, with both zero and nonzero delivery dates. `release.test.mjs`
exercises all nine exports together and persists the previously manual summary
checks for empty input, zero totals, aggregation, and frozen inputs.

Run `node --test` from the repository root. No dependencies are needed.
Verified after the final release changes on 2026-10-06: all 41 tests passed with no failures,
skips or pending tests; `git diff --check` and `git diff --cached --check` passed.
`handoff.json` records the ten current policy fields, all nine implemented
exports, deferred/cancelled identifiers and no unresolved release requirements.
MULTI_CURRENCY and FRAUD_SCORING remain deferred; LOYALTY_POINTS stays cancelled.

The final audit found no pending release implementation or unresolved merge.
Both pipeline exports remain integrated. The final edits are in the working
tree; no new commits or branches were created for this request. Earlier worker
handoffs describe their historical checkpoints and are superseded by this plan,
`handoff.json`, and the final release section of `MERGE_HANDOFF.md`.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library: release plan and handoff

## Scope and current code state

Implement the specified local library using Node.js built-ins, with no input mutation anywhere.
This conversation implements ONLY `normalizeCart`. All other exports are pending for later conversations.
`MULTI_CURRENCY` and `LOYALTY_POINTS` are separate FUTURE backlog ideas, excluded from this release.

- `cart.mjs` exports `normalizeCart`; `priceOrder` is absent.
- `receipt.mjs`, `inventory.mjs`, `returns.mjs`, `pipeline.mjs`, and `summary.mjs` remain comment-only placeholders.
- `cart.test.mjs` covers invalid lines, trimming, duplicate pairs, global first appearance, case sensitivity, zero prices, special SKU strings, fresh exact-shape outputs, frozen inputs, repeated references, and sparse arrays.
- Existing `smoke.test.mjs` covers an empty cart and a valid line.
- Verification is configured as `unit` in `.dip/config.json`: `node --test` (also `npm test`). DIP verification and the latest checkpoint hold the actual check result.
- No branches or commits are created by this session.

## Fixed release policy

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 10,
  "couponCapPercent": 15,
  "taxBase": "subtotal",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 30,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Release contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep lines with a string SKU that is nonempty after trimming, a positive integer quantity, and a nonnegative integer unit price.
Drop invalid lines, including null, without coercion. Trim SKU and combine quantities only for the same trimmed SKU AND price.
Preserve global first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; never modify input.
The implementation uses nested maps keyed by SKU and price and a separate ordered result array.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`.
Subtotal sums normalized quantity times price. `couponPercent` defaults to 0 and is clamped to [0,15].
Round discount once: `Math.round(subtotalCents*couponPercent/100)`.
Tax base is the original subtotal; round tax once: `Math.round(subtotalCents*10/100)`.
`shippingCents` defaults to 0 and is added after tax.
Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` takes `order={id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns exactly
`{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount:sumOfNormalizedQuantities,currency:'USD'}`.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency`, followed by rows in input order using LF separators.
Fields containing comma, quote or newline use CSV quotes with embedded quotes doubled.
No trailing newline. Empty input returns just the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` takes an object of nonnegative integer stock counts by SKU; absent SKU means 0.
Aggregate normalized quantities across prices. Check ALL availability before subtracting anything.
If any SKU is insufficient, throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')`.
Otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Apply these checks in order:

1. Status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. `deliveredDay` and `nowDay` must be nonnegative integers and `nowDay>=deliveredDay`, otherwise reason `'date'`.
3. `nowDay-deliveredDay` must be <=30, otherwise reason `'window'`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents:eligible?priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents:0,currency:'USD'}`,
where eligible is the eligibility result.
Preserve both exports when implementing either.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sumOfTotalCents,units:sumOfItemCount}`.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library: release plan and handoff

## Scope and current code state

Implement the specified local library using Node.js built-ins, with no input mutation anywhere.
`normalizeCart` and `priceOrder` are implemented. All other exports are pending for later conversations.
`MULTI_CURRENCY` and `LOYALTY_POINTS` are separate FUTURE backlog ideas, excluded from this release.

- `cart.mjs` exports `normalizeCart` and `priceOrder`.
- `receipt.mjs`, `inventory.mjs`, `returns.mjs`, `pipeline.mjs`, and `summary.mjs` remain comment-only placeholders.
- `cart.test.mjs` covers invalid lines, trimming, duplicate pairs, global first appearance, case sensitivity, zero prices, special SKU strings, fresh exact-shape outputs, frozen inputs, repeated references, and sparse arrays.
- Pricing tests cover defaults, exact output shape, coupon clamping and fractional percentages, rounding once per order, 7% tax after discount excluding shipping, normalized inputs and immutability.
- Existing `smoke.test.mjs` covers an empty cart and a valid line.
- Verification is configured as `unit` in `.dip/config.json`: `node --test` (also `npm test`). DIP verification and the latest checkpoint hold the actual check result.
- No branches or commits are created by this session.

## Fixed release policy

The revised policy below supersedes the earlier 10% tax rate, 15% coupon cap, tax on original subtotal and 30-day return window.
Pending adapters must use this revised contract when they are implemented.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 7,
  "couponCapPercent": 20,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 14,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Release contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep lines with a string SKU that is nonempty after trimming, a positive integer quantity, and a nonnegative integer unit price.
Drop invalid lines, including null, without coercion. Trim SKU and combine quantities only for the same trimmed SKU AND price.
Preserve global first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; never modify input.
The implementation uses nested maps keyed by SKU and price and a separate ordered result array.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`.
Subtotal sums normalized quantity times price. `couponPercent` defaults to 0 and is clamped to [0,20].
Round discount once: `Math.round(subtotalCents*couponPercent/100)`.
Tax base is subtotal AFTER the rounded discount, excluding shipping; round tax once: `Math.round((subtotalCents-discountCents)*7/100)`.
`shippingCents` defaults to 0 and is added after tax.
Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` takes `order={id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns exactly
`{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount:sumOfNormalizedQuantities,currency:'USD'}`.
Use the implemented revised pricing directly, including 7% tax after discount with shipping excluded from the tax base.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency`, followed by rows in input order using LF separators.
Fields containing comma, quote or newline use CSV quotes with embedded quotes doubled.
No trailing newline. Empty input returns just the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` takes an object of nonnegative integer stock counts by SKU; absent SKU means 0.
Aggregate normalized quantities across prices. Check ALL availability before subtracting anything.
If any SKU is insufficient, throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')`.
Otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Apply these checks in order:

1. Status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. `deliveredDay` and `nowDay` must be nonnegative integers and `nowDay>=deliveredDay`, otherwise reason `'date'`.
3. `nowDay-deliveredDay` must be <=14 (day 14 is eligible; day 15 is not), otherwise reason `'window'`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents:eligible?priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents:0,currency:'USD'}`,
where eligible is the eligibility result.
Use the pending inclusive 14-day return contract and revised `priceOrder` total for refunds.
Preserve both exports when implementing either.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sumOfTotalCents,units:sumOfItemCount}`.

## Execution plan and DIP tasks

The normalization and revised pricing rows have code implemented. All remaining release tasks stay pending in backlog until a later conversation authorizes development.
Task dependencies indicate required library contracts; they do not authorize implementing more in this session.

Inventory can follow normalizeCart independently; return eligibility, CSV and summary have independent input contracts.
Implement receipt and pipeline compositions after their dependencies. Run the configured checks via DIP `task_verify` for each completed task and checkpoint any unfinished work.

Read this plan and the relevant DIP task via `task_get` before resuming. Claim only the work being started, using the new conversation's actor/session.
Keep pending exports and FUTURE ideas separate, and preserve the fixed policy unless the user explicitly changes it.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library: release plan and handoff

## Scope and current code state

Implement the specified local library using Node.js built-ins, with no input mutation anywhere.
`normalizeCart`, `priceOrder`, and `formatSummary` are implemented. All other exports are pending for later conversations.
`MULTI_CURRENCY` and `FRAUD_SCORING` are separate FUTURE backlog ideas, excluded from this release.
`LOYALTY_POINTS` is cancelled entirely and is not a future commitment.

- `cart.mjs` exports `normalizeCart` and `priceOrder`.
- `summary.mjs` exports `formatSummary`; `summary.test.mjs` covers empty input, exact output shape, sums, zero totals, frozen inputs, repeated references and independent results.
- `receipt.mjs`, `inventory.mjs`, `returns.mjs`, and `pipeline.mjs` remain comment-only placeholders.
- `cart.test.mjs` covers invalid lines, trimming, duplicate pairs, global first appearance, case sensitivity, zero prices, special SKU strings, fresh exact-shape outputs, frozen inputs, repeated references, and sparse arrays.
- Pricing tests cover defaults, exact output shape, coupon clamping and fractional percentages, rounding once per order, 7% tax after discount excluding shipping, normalized inputs and immutability.
- Existing `smoke.test.mjs` covers an empty cart and a valid line.
- Verification is configured as `unit` in `.dip/config.json`: `node --test` (also `npm test`). DIP verification and the latest checkpoint hold the actual check result.
- No branches or commits are created by this session.

## Fixed release policy

The revised policy below supersedes the earlier 10% tax rate, 15% coupon cap, tax on original subtotal and 30-day return window.
Pending adapters must use this revised contract when they are implemented.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 7,
  "couponCapPercent": 20,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 14,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Release contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep lines with a string SKU that is nonempty after trimming, a positive integer quantity, and a nonnegative integer unit price.
Drop invalid lines, including null, without coercion. Trim SKU and combine quantities only for the same trimmed SKU AND price.
Preserve global first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; never modify input.
The implementation uses nested maps keyed by SKU and price and a separate ordered result array.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`.
Subtotal sums normalized quantity times price. `couponPercent` defaults to 0 and is clamped to [0,20].
Round discount once: `Math.round(subtotalCents*couponPercent/100)`.
Tax base is subtotal AFTER the rounded discount, excluding shipping; round tax once: `Math.round((subtotalCents-discountCents)*7/100)`.
`shippingCents` defaults to 0 and is added after tax.
Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` takes `order={id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns exactly
`{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount:sumOfNormalizedQuantities,currency:'USD'}`.
Use the implemented revised pricing directly, including 7% tax after discount with shipping excluded from the tax base.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency`, followed by rows in input order using LF separators.
Fields containing comma, quote or newline use CSV quotes with embedded quotes doubled.
No trailing newline. Empty input returns just the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` takes an object of nonnegative integer stock counts by SKU; absent SKU means 0.
Aggregate normalized quantities across prices. Check ALL availability before subtracting anything.
If any SKU is insufficient, throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')`.
Otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Apply these checks in order:

1. Status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. `deliveredDay` and `nowDay` must be nonnegative integers and `nowDay>=deliveredDay`, otherwise reason `'date'`.
3. `nowDay-deliveredDay` must be <=14 (day 14 is eligible; day 15 is not), otherwise reason `'window'`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents:eligible?priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents:0,currency:'USD'}`,
where eligible is the eligibility result.
Use the pending inclusive 14-day return contract and revised `priceOrder` total for refunds.
Preserve both exports when implementing either.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sumOfTotalCents,units:sumOfItemCount}`.

## Execution plan and DIP tasks

The normalization, revised pricing and summary rows have code implemented. All remaining release tasks stay pending in backlog until a later conversation authorizes development.
Task dependencies indicate required library contracts; they do not authorize implementing more in this session.

| returnOrder | Pending | canReturn, priceOrder | task_88d4b238-d497-4169-bb98-c364c49ac1b8 |
| formatSummary + future decisions | Implemented; see verification/checkpoint | None | task_30212db7c43196aa066a339d65738f12445108b4610c59f11548a6e72a6939b6 |
| MULTI_CURRENCY | FUTURE; out of release | None | task_a9c6510d-8704-4f39-86ef-e7d443342aa8 |

The original pending pricing task `task_3bba6c27-d41f-4cdd-bd72-5f3c8ea9e645` is superseded by the revised pricing task above; pending adapter dependencies point to the revised task.
The original pending summary task `task_0e7b9c7b-2f28-4fe8-ae52-bd97a6c6fae7` is superseded by the implemented summary task above.
Suggested next step, when authorized: implement `buildReceipt` using the implemented revised pricing.
Inventory can follow normalizeCart independently; return eligibility and CSV have independent input contracts.
Implement receipt and pipeline compositions after their dependencies. Run the configured checks via DIP `task_verify` for each completed task and checkpoint any unfinished work.

## Local handoff

Read this plan and the relevant DIP task via `task_get` before resuming. Claim only the work being started, using the new conversation's actor/session.
Keep pending exports and FUTURE ideas separate, keep LOYALTY_POINTS cancelled, and preserve the fixed policy unless the user explicitly changes it.
DIP captures activity automatically; intent, plans, dependencies, verification and handoff are saved in `.dip`.
Prompt/plan capture was observed by `dip doctor`. It reported the recorder/watcher inactive; no machine settings were changed.
The full library release remains unfinished even when normalization, pricing and summary pass their checks.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library: release plan and handoff

## Scope and current code state

Implement the specified local library using Node.js built-ins, with no input mutation anywhere.
`normalizeCart`, `priceOrder`, and `formatSummary` are implemented. All other exports are pending for later conversations.
`MULTI_CURRENCY` and `FRAUD_SCORING` are separate FUTURE backlog ideas, excluded from this release.
`LOYALTY_POINTS` is cancelled entirely and is not a future commitment.

- `cart.mjs` exports `normalizeCart` and `priceOrder`.
- `summary.mjs` exports `formatSummary`; `summary.test.mjs` covers empty input, exact output shape, sums, zero totals, frozen inputs, repeated references and independent results.
- `receipt.mjs`, `inventory.mjs`, `returns.mjs`, and `pipeline.mjs` remain comment-only placeholders.
- `cart.test.mjs` covers invalid lines, trimming, duplicate pairs, global first appearance, case sensitivity, zero prices, special SKU strings, fresh exact-shape outputs, frozen inputs, repeated references, and sparse arrays.
- Pricing tests cover defaults, exact output shape, coupon clamping and fractional percentages, rounding once per order, 7% tax after discount excluding shipping, normalized inputs and immutability.
- Existing `smoke.test.mjs` covers an empty cart and a valid line.
- Verification is configured as `unit` in `.dip/config.json`: `node --test` (also `npm test`). DIP verification and the latest checkpoint hold the actual check result.
- No branches or commits are created by this session.

## Fixed release policy

The revised policy below supersedes the earlier 10% tax rate, 15% coupon cap, tax on original subtotal and 30-day return window.
Pending adapters must use this revised contract when they are implemented.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 7,
  "couponCapPercent": 20,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 14,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Release contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep lines with a string SKU that is nonempty after trimming, a positive integer quantity, and a nonnegative integer unit price.
Drop invalid lines, including null, without coercion. Trim SKU and combine quantities only for the same trimmed SKU AND price.
Preserve global first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; never modify input.
The implementation uses nested maps keyed by SKU and price and a separate ordered result array.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`.
Subtotal sums normalized quantity times price. `couponPercent` defaults to 0 and is clamped to [0,20].
Round discount once: `Math.round(subtotalCents*couponPercent/100)`.
Tax base is subtotal AFTER the rounded discount, excluding shipping; round tax once: `Math.round((subtotalCents-discountCents)*7/100)`.
`shippingCents` defaults to 0 and is added after tax.
Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` takes `order={id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns exactly
`{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount:sumOfNormalizedQuantities,currency:'USD'}`.
Use the implemented revised pricing directly, including 7% tax after discount with shipping excluded from the tax base.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency`, followed by rows in input order using LF separators.
Fields containing comma, quote or newline use CSV quotes with embedded quotes doubled.
No trailing newline. Empty input returns just the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` takes an object of nonnegative integer stock counts by SKU; absent SKU means 0.
Aggregate normalized quantities across prices. Check ALL availability before subtracting anything.
If any SKU is insufficient, throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')`.
Otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Apply these checks in order:

1. Status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. `deliveredDay` and `nowDay` must be nonnegative integers and `nowDay>=deliveredDay`, otherwise reason `'date'`.
3. `nowDay-deliveredDay` must be <=14 (day 14 is eligible; day 15 is not), otherwise reason `'window'`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents:eligible?priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents:0,currency:'USD'}`,
where eligible is the eligibility result.
Use the pending inclusive 14-day return contract and revised `priceOrder` total for refunds.
Preserve both exports when implementing either.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sumOfTotalCents,units:sumOfItemCount}`.

## Execution plan and DIP tasks

The normalization, revised pricing and summary rows have code implemented. All remaining release tasks stay pending in backlog until a later conversation authorizes development.
Task dependencies indicate required library contracts; they do not authorize implementing more in this session.

The original pending pricing task `task_3bba6c27-d41f-4cdd-bd72-5f3c8ea9e645` is superseded by the revised pricing task above; pending adapter dependencies point to the revised task.
The original pending summary task `task_0e7b9c7b-2f28-4fe8-ae52-bd97a6c6fae7` is superseded by the implemented summary task above.
Suggested next step, when authorized: implement `buildReceipt` using the implemented revised pricing.
Inventory can follow normalizeCart independently; return eligibility and CSV have independent input contracts.
Implement receipt and pipeline compositions after their dependencies. Run the configured checks via DIP `task_verify` for each completed task and checkpoint any unfinished work.

## Local handoff

Read this plan and the relevant DIP task via `task_get` before resuming. Claim only the work being started, using the new conversation's actor/session.
Keep pending exports and FUTURE ideas separate, keep LOYALTY_POINTS cancelled, and preserve the fixed policy unless the user explicitly changes it.
DIP captures activity automatically; intent, plans, dependencies, verification and handoff are saved in `.dip`.

The full library release remains unfinished even when normalization, pricing and summary pass their checks.

# Worker A handoff

## Implemented in this worktree

- `inventory.mjs` exports `reserveInventory(stock, cart)`. It normalizes the cart,
  aggregates quantities by SKU across prices, checks every SKU before constructing
  the updated stock, and throws `RangeError('insufficient stock')` on shortage.
  Missing own stock keys have zero availability, including names inherited from
  Object.prototype. Successful reservations return a fresh object and preserve
  unrelated stock entries. Stock and cart are never modified.
- `pipeline.mjs` adds `fulfillOrder(order, stock)` returning exactly
  `{ receipt: buildReceipt(order), stock: reserveInventory(stock, order.cart) }`.
  Existing pipeline content was preserved. At the start, this worktree's pipeline
  contained only a comment; at handoff it exports only `fulfillOrder`.
- `inventory.test.mjs` adds six reservation tests; `fulfillment.test.mjs` adds
  three fulfillment tests. They cover normalization, cross-price aggregation,
  shortage atomicity, missing and special SKU names, independent results, frozen
  inputs, repeated references, exact composition, defaults and revised pricing.

## Verification

Configured DIP `unit` check (`node --test`) passed: 34 tests, zero failures.
The verification reported no code or intent changes during the check.
`git diff --check` also passed. Only handoff and tracking records were added after
these checks; the tested source and tests are unchanged.

## Ownership and integration

Current task: `task_b95d0da0a4eed85dc7235f91cd7822d70b798e8dc57cd3030f5c279062976853`.
Worker A claimed inventory, pipeline, dedicated tests and this handoff using its
hook actor/session through DIP. The claim succeeded. Shared coordination context
showed worker B working on return functionality with a claim that excluded
`pipeline.mjs` while worker A held it. No sibling worktree was inspected.
Worker A releases its claim after saving the completion checkpoint.

Integration must preserve this `fulfillOrder` export and any return exports from
worker B when combining changes to `pipeline.mjs`, with all required imports.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library: release plan and handoff

## Scope and current code state

Implement the specified local library using Node.js built-ins, with no input mutation anywhere.
`normalizeCart`, `priceOrder`, and `formatSummary` are implemented. All other exports are pending for later conversations.
`MULTI_CURRENCY` and `FRAUD_SCORING` are separate FUTURE backlog ideas, excluded from this release.
`LOYALTY_POINTS` is cancelled entirely and is not a future commitment.

- `cart.mjs` exports `normalizeCart` and `priceOrder`.
- `summary.mjs` exports `formatSummary`; `summary.test.mjs` covers empty input, exact output shape, sums, zero totals, frozen inputs, repeated references and independent results.
- `receipt.mjs`, `inventory.mjs`, `returns.mjs`, and `pipeline.mjs` remain comment-only placeholders.
- `cart.test.mjs` covers invalid lines, trimming, duplicate pairs, global first appearance, case sensitivity, zero prices, special SKU strings, fresh exact-shape outputs, frozen inputs, repeated references, and sparse arrays.
- Pricing tests cover defaults, exact output shape, coupon clamping and fractional percentages, rounding once per order, 7% tax after discount excluding shipping, normalized inputs and immutability.
- Existing `smoke.test.mjs` covers an empty cart and a valid line.
- Verification is configured as `unit` in `.dip/config.json`: `node --test` (also `npm test`). DIP verification and the latest checkpoint hold the actual check result.
- No branches or commits are created by this session.

## Fixed release policy

The revised policy below supersedes the earlier 10% tax rate, 15% coupon cap, tax on original subtotal and 30-day return window.
Pending adapters must use this revised contract when they are implemented.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 7,
  "couponCapPercent": 20,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 14,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Release contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep lines with a string SKU that is nonempty after trimming, a positive integer quantity, and a nonnegative integer unit price.
Drop invalid lines, including null, without coercion. Trim SKU and combine quantities only for the same trimmed SKU AND price.
Preserve global first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; never modify input.
The implementation uses nested maps keyed by SKU and price and a separate ordered result array.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`.
Subtotal sums normalized quantity times price. `couponPercent` defaults to 0 and is clamped to [0,20].
Round discount once: `Math.round(subtotalCents*couponPercent/100)`.
Tax base is subtotal AFTER the rounded discount, excluding shipping; round tax once: `Math.round((subtotalCents-discountCents)*7/100)`.
`shippingCents` defaults to 0 and is added after tax.
Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` takes `order={id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns exactly
`{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount:sumOfNormalizedQuantities,currency:'USD'}`.
Use the implemented revised pricing directly, including 7% tax after discount with shipping excluded from the tax base.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency`, followed by rows in input order using LF separators.
Fields containing comma, quote or newline use CSV quotes with embedded quotes doubled.
No trailing newline. Empty input returns just the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` takes an object of nonnegative integer stock counts by SKU; absent SKU means 0.
Aggregate normalized quantities across prices. Check ALL availability before subtracting anything.
If any SKU is insufficient, throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')`.
Otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Apply these checks in order:

1. Status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. `deliveredDay` and `nowDay` must be nonnegative integers and `nowDay>=deliveredDay`, otherwise reason `'date'`.
3. `nowDay-deliveredDay` must be <=14 (day 14 is eligible; day 15 is not), otherwise reason `'window'`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents:eligible?priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents:0,currency:'USD'}`,
where eligible is the eligibility result.
Use the pending inclusive 14-day return contract and revised `priceOrder` total for refunds.
Preserve both exports when implementing either.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sumOfTotalCents,units:sumOfItemCount}`.

## Execution plan and DIP tasks

The normalization, revised pricing and summary rows have code implemented. All remaining release tasks stay pending in backlog until a later conversation authorizes development.
Task dependencies indicate required library contracts; they do not authorize implementing more in this session.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library: release plan and handoff

## Scope and current code state

Implement the specified local library using Node.js built-ins, with no input mutation anywhere.
`normalizeCart`, `priceOrder`, and `formatSummary` are implemented. All other exports are pending for later conversations.
`MULTI_CURRENCY` and `FRAUD_SCORING` are separate FUTURE backlog ideas, excluded from this release.
`LOYALTY_POINTS` is cancelled entirely and is not a future commitment.

- `cart.mjs` exports `normalizeCart` and `priceOrder`.
- `summary.mjs` exports `formatSummary`; `summary.test.mjs` covers empty input, exact output shape, sums, zero totals, frozen inputs, repeated references and independent results.
- `receipt.mjs`, `inventory.mjs`, `returns.mjs`, and `pipeline.mjs` remain comment-only placeholders.
- `cart.test.mjs` covers invalid lines, trimming, duplicate pairs, global first appearance, case sensitivity, zero prices, special SKU strings, fresh exact-shape outputs, frozen inputs, repeated references, and sparse arrays.
- Pricing tests cover defaults, exact output shape, coupon clamping and fractional percentages, rounding once per order, 7% tax after discount excluding shipping, normalized inputs and immutability.
- Existing `smoke.test.mjs` covers an empty cart and a valid line.
- Verification is configured as `unit` in `.dip/config.json`: `node --test` (also `npm test`). DIP verification and the latest checkpoint hold the actual check result.
- No branches or commits are created by this session.

## Fixed release policy

The revised policy below supersedes the earlier 10% tax rate, 15% coupon cap, tax on original subtotal and 30-day return window.
Pending adapters must use this revised contract when they are implemented.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 7,
  "couponCapPercent": 20,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 14,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Release contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep lines with a string SKU that is nonempty after trimming, a positive integer quantity, and a nonnegative integer unit price.
Drop invalid lines, including null, without coercion. Trim SKU and combine quantities only for the same trimmed SKU AND price.
Preserve global first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; never modify input.
The implementation uses nested maps keyed by SKU and price and a separate ordered result array.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`.
Subtotal sums normalized quantity times price. `couponPercent` defaults to 0 and is clamped to [0,20].
Round discount once: `Math.round(subtotalCents*couponPercent/100)`.
Tax base is subtotal AFTER the rounded discount, excluding shipping; round tax once: `Math.round((subtotalCents-discountCents)*7/100)`.
`shippingCents` defaults to 0 and is added after tax.
Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` takes `order={id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns exactly
`{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount:sumOfNormalizedQuantities,currency:'USD'}`.
Use the implemented revised pricing directly, including 7% tax after discount with shipping excluded from the tax base.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency`, followed by rows in input order using LF separators.
Fields containing comma, quote or newline use CSV quotes with embedded quotes doubled.
No trailing newline. Empty input returns just the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` takes an object of nonnegative integer stock counts by SKU; absent SKU means 0.
Aggregate normalized quantities across prices. Check ALL availability before subtracting anything.
If any SKU is insufficient, throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')`.
Otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Apply these checks in order:

1. Status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. `deliveredDay` and `nowDay` must be nonnegative integers and `nowDay>=deliveredDay`, otherwise reason `'date'`.
3. `nowDay-deliveredDay` must be <=14 (day 14 is eligible; day 15 is not), otherwise reason `'window'`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents:eligible?priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents:0,currency:'USD'}`,
where eligible is the eligibility result.
Use the pending inclusive 14-day return contract and revised `priceOrder` total for refunds.
Preserve both exports when implementing either.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sumOfTotalCents,units:sumOfItemCount}`.

## Execution plan and DIP tasks

The normalization, revised pricing and summary rows have code implemented. All remaining release tasks stay pending in backlog until a later conversation authorizes development.
Task dependencies indicate required library contracts; they do not authorize implementing more in this session.

| returnOrder | Pending | canReturn, priceOrder | task_88d4b238-d497-4169-bb98-c364c49ac1b8 |
| formatSummary + future decisions | Implemented; see verification/checkpoint | None | task_30212db7c43196aa066a339d65738f12445108b4610c59f11548a6e72a6939b6 |

The original pending pricing task `task_3bba6c27-d41f-4cdd-bd72-5f3c8ea9e645` is superseded by the revised pricing task above; pending adapter dependencies point to the revised task.
The original pending summary task `task_0e7b9c7b-2f28-4fe8-ae52-bd97a6c6fae7` is superseded by the implemented summary task above.

Inventory can follow normalizeCart independently; return eligibility and CSV have independent input contracts.
Implement receipt and pipeline compositions after their dependencies. Run the configured checks via DIP `task_verify` for each completed task and checkpoint any unfinished work.

## Local handoff

Read this plan and the relevant DIP task via `task_get` before resuming. Claim only the work being started, using the new conversation's actor/session.

# Worker B return processing handoff

Current task: `task_32df112b8a5484c3015a05185080e66ae71a2ee7a2500a93315e0e2ff08b66b8`.
This note supplements `PROJECT_PLAN.md`, whose code-state summary predates this work.

`returns.mjs` now exports `canReturn(order, {nowDay})`: exact delivered status,
nonnegative integer dates with nowDay at or after delivery, then an inclusive
14-day window. It returns exactly `{eligible,reason}` without mutation.
`returns.test.mjs` passed all four local tests.

`pipeline.mjs` now exports `returnOrder(order, context)`, composing `canReturn`
with the existing `priceOrder` total for eligible returns and refund 0 otherwise.
It returns exactly `{eligible,reason,refundCents,currency:'USD'}`. Rejected
returns never read cart/options. Pricing remains the revised 20% coupon cap,
discount rounded once per order, 7% tax after discount excluding shipping,
then shipping added to the total. Inputs are never mutated.

`pipeline.return.test.mjs` covers normalized inputs, coupon cap, order rounding,
shipping, defaults, empty cart, zero refund with all three rejection reasons,
no pricing access on rejection, frozen inputs and independent exact outputs.
DIP `task_verify` ran the configured `unit` check (`node --test`): all 33 tests
passed with no code or intent changes during the check, including eight new
return tests. Evidence is stored on the current task in `.dip`.

Ownership was checked through DIP only; no other worktree was inspected.
The initial combined claim was rejected, so worker B claimed returns, its
distinct test files and this handoff while waiting to claim the shared pipeline.
DIP subsequently granted the combined scope before any pipeline edit.
The local pipeline still had only its original comment; `returnOrder` and its
two imports were appended. No existing local exports were removed.
`fulfillOrder` is not present in this worktree. Separate worktrees do not
automatically receive each other's edits: integration must combine worker A's
fulfillment implementation/imports with worker B's return implementation/imports,
retain both exports, and run the full suite again. An add/add-content conflict
in `pipeline.mjs` is possible; do not resolve it by choosing only one side.

The legacy pending `canReturn` task (`task_992ae66f-8fb0-401e-90e3-a2f38bf4f37d`)
and `returnOrder` task (`task_88d4b238-d497-4169-bb98-c364c49ac1b8`) are superseded
by this combined implementation task. Shared `PROJECT_PLAN.md` was left
untouched because it was owned by another task; its pending return rows are
historical and should be updated during integration using this verified state.

Worker B does not implement inventory reservation or fulfillment.
`MULTI_CURRENCY` and `FRAUD_SCORING` remain future backlog ideas;
`LOYALTY_POINTS` remains cancelled. No commits or branches were created.
The harness is responsible for committing code and `.dip` records.

No worker B implementation remains pending. Next: harness commit, combine
the independently developed pipeline exports, update the shared release state,
and verify the integrated code. Full release completion is not asserted here.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library: release plan and handoff

## Scope and current code state

Implement the specified local library using Node.js built-ins, with no input mutation anywhere.
All nine current release exports are implemented in this integrated worktree.
Worker A's inventory/fulfillment and worker B's eligibility/refund implementations are combined in `pipeline.mjs`.
The receipt implementation survived the interrupted conversation; integration completes its verification and handoff.
`MULTI_CURRENCY` and `FRAUD_SCORING` are separate FUTURE backlog ideas, excluded from this release.
`LOYALTY_POINTS` is cancelled entirely and is not a future commitment.

- `cart.mjs` exports `normalizeCart` and `priceOrder`.
- `summary.mjs` exports `formatSummary`; `summary.test.mjs` covers empty input, exact output shape, sums, zero totals, frozen inputs, repeated references and independent results.
- `receipt.mjs` exports `buildReceipt` and `renderCSV`; `receipt.test.mjs` covers exact shape, revised pricing, normalized units, defaults, immutable inputs and CSV escaping/order/LF separators.
- `inventory.mjs` exports `reserveInventory`; its tests cover cross-price aggregation, atomic failure, missing/special keys and immutable inputs.
- `returns.mjs` exports `canReturn`; its tests cover ordered status/date/window checks and inclusive day 14.
- `pipeline.mjs` exports both `fulfillOrder` and `returnOrder`; the two worker suites cover composition, pricing, failures and immutability.
- `integration.test.mjs` exercises all nine exports together: normalization, reservation, receipt, CSV, summary, day-14 refund and day-15 rejection, plus an atomic shortage.
- `cart.test.mjs` covers invalid lines, trimming, duplicate pairs, global first appearance, case sensitivity, zero prices, special SKU strings, fresh exact-shape outputs, frozen inputs, repeated references, and sparse arrays.
- Pricing tests cover defaults, exact output shape, coupon clamping and fractional percentages, rounding once per order, 7% tax after discount excluding shipping, normalized inputs and immutability.
- Existing `smoke.test.mjs` covers an empty cart and a valid line.
- Verification is configured as `unit` in `.dip/config.json`: `node --test` (also `npm test`). DIP verification and the latest checkpoint hold the actual check result.
- The integration request authorizes completing the existing worker B merge and committing its resolution. No history is rewritten or new branch created.

## Fixed release policy

The revised policy below supersedes the earlier 10% tax rate, 15% coupon cap, tax on original subtotal and 30-day return window.
All adapters use this revised contract.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 7,
  "couponCapPercent": 20,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 14,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Release contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep lines with a string SKU that is nonempty after trimming, a positive integer quantity, and a nonnegative integer unit price.
Drop invalid lines, including null, without coercion. Trim SKU and combine quantities only for the same trimmed SKU AND price.
Preserve global first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; never modify input.
The implementation uses nested maps keyed by SKU and price and a separate ordered result array.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`.
Subtotal sums normalized quantity times price. `couponPercent` defaults to 0 and is clamped to [0,20].
Round discount once: `Math.round(subtotalCents*couponPercent/100)`.
Tax base is subtotal AFTER the rounded discount, excluding shipping; round tax once: `Math.round((subtotalCents-discountCents)*7/100)`.
`shippingCents` defaults to 0 and is added after tax.
Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` takes `order={id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns exactly
`{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount:sumOfNormalizedQuantities,currency:'USD'}`.
Use the implemented revised pricing directly, including 7% tax after discount with shipping excluded from the tax base.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency`, followed by rows in input order using LF separators.
Fields containing comma, quote or newline use CSV quotes with embedded quotes doubled.
No trailing newline. Empty input returns just the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` takes an object of nonnegative integer stock counts by SKU; absent SKU means 0.
Aggregate normalized quantities across prices. Check ALL availability before subtracting anything.
If any SKU is insufficient, throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')`.
Otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Apply these checks in order:

1. Status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. `deliveredDay` and `nowDay` must be nonnegative integers and `nowDay>=deliveredDay`, otherwise reason `'date'`.
3. `nowDay-deliveredDay` must be <=14 (day 14 is eligible; day 15 is not), otherwise reason `'window'`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents:eligible?priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents:0,currency:'USD'}`,
where eligible is the eligibility result.
Use the inclusive 14-day return contract and revised `priceOrder` total for refunds.
Preserve both exports when implementing either.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sumOfTotalCents,units:sumOfItemCount}`.

The integration request authorizes completing the current release. Every release row below now has code implemented.
Configured verification on the combined code establishes completion; worker-only results do not establish integrated readiness.

# Local order-processing library: release plan and handoff

## Scope and current code state

Implement the specified local library using Node.js built-ins, with no input mutation anywhere.
All nine current release exports are implemented in this integrated worktree.
Worker A's inventory/fulfillment and worker B's eligibility/refund implementations are combined in `pipeline.mjs`.
Receipt verification and the worker merge were completed during integration. The final change updates currency, CSV record separators and return eligibility; no other release implementation remains pending.
`MULTI_CURRENCY` and `FRAUD_SCORING` are separate FUTURE backlog ideas, excluded from this release.
`LOYALTY_POINTS` is cancelled entirely and is not a future commitment.

- `cart.mjs` exports `normalizeCart` and `priceOrder`.
- `summary.mjs` exports `formatSummary`; `summary.test.mjs` covers empty input, exact output shape, sums, zero totals, frozen inputs, repeated references and independent results.
- `receipt.mjs` exports `buildReceipt` and `renderCSV`; `receipt.test.mjs` covers exact shape, revised pricing, normalized units, defaults, immutable inputs and CSV escaping/order/CRLF separators without a trailing newline.
- `inventory.mjs` exports `reserveInventory`; its tests cover cross-price aggregation, atomic failure, missing/special keys and immutable inputs.
- `returns.mjs` exports `canReturn`; its tests cover ordered status/date/window checks and inclusive day 16 and rejection on day 17.
- `pipeline.mjs` exports both `fulfillOrder` and `returnOrder`; the two worker suites cover composition, pricing, failures and immutability.
- `integration.test.mjs` exercises all nine exports together: normalization, reservation, receipt, CSV, summary, day-14, day-15 and day-16 refunds and day-17 rejection, plus an atomic shortage.
- `cart.test.mjs` covers invalid lines, trimming, duplicate pairs, global first appearance, case sensitivity, zero prices, special SKU strings, fresh exact-shape outputs, frozen inputs, repeated references, and sparse arrays.
- Pricing tests cover defaults, exact output shape, coupon clamping and fractional percentages, rounding once per order, 7% tax after discount excluding shipping, normalized inputs and immutability.
- Existing `smoke.test.mjs` covers an empty cart and a valid line.
- Verification is configured as `unit` in `.dip/config.json`: `node --test` (also `npm test`). DIP verification and the latest checkpoint hold the actual check result.
- The earlier integration merge is complete; no active merge or unmerged paths remain. This final change creates no commits or branches.

## Fixed release policy

The revised policy below supersedes the earlier 10% tax rate, 15% coupon cap, tax on original subtotal and 30-day return window.
The final user change additionally supersedes USD, LF CSV separators and the inclusive 14-day return window with EUR, CRLF and 16 days inclusive. All adapters use the current contract below.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 7,
  "couponCapPercent": 20,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "EUR",
  "csvNewline": "CRLF",
  "returnWindowDays": 16,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Release contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep lines with a string SKU that is nonempty after trimming, a positive integer quantity, and a nonnegative integer unit price.
Drop invalid lines, including null, without coercion. Trim SKU and combine quantities only for the same trimmed SKU AND price.
Preserve global first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; never modify input.
The implementation uses nested maps keyed by SKU and price and a separate ordered result array.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`.
Subtotal sums normalized quantity times price. `couponPercent` defaults to 0 and is clamped to [0,20].
Round discount once: `Math.round(subtotalCents*couponPercent/100)`.
Tax base is subtotal AFTER the rounded discount, excluding shipping; round tax once: `Math.round((subtotalCents-discountCents)*7/100)`.
`shippingCents` defaults to 0 and is added after tax.
Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` takes `order={id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns exactly
`{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount:sumOfNormalizedQuantities,currency:'EUR'}`.
Use the implemented revised pricing directly, including 7% tax after discount with shipping excluded from the tax base.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency`, followed by rows in input order using CRLF record separators.
Fields containing comma, quote or newline use CSV quotes with embedded quotes doubled.
No trailing newline. Empty input returns just the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` takes an object of nonnegative integer stock counts by SKU; absent SKU means 0.
Aggregate normalized quantities across prices. Check ALL availability before subtracting anything.
If any SKU is insufficient, throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')`.
Otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Apply these checks in order:

1. Status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. `deliveredDay` and `nowDay` must be nonnegative integers and `nowDay>=deliveredDay`, otherwise reason `'date'`.
3. `nowDay-deliveredDay` must be <=16 (day 16 is eligible; day 17 is not), otherwise reason `'window'`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents:eligible?priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents:0,currency:'EUR'}`,
where eligible is the eligibility result.
Use the inclusive 16-day return contract and revised `priceOrder` total for refunds.
Preserve both exports when implementing either.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sumOfTotalCents,units:sumOfItemCount}`.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library: release plan and handoff

## Scope and current code state

Implement the specified local library using Node.js built-ins, with no input mutation anywhere.
All nine current release exports are implemented in this integrated worktree.
Worker A's inventory/fulfillment and worker B's eligibility/refund implementations are combined in `pipeline.mjs`.
Receipt verification and the worker merge were completed during integration. The final change updates currency, CSV record separators and return eligibility; no other release implementation remains pending.
`MULTI_CURRENCY` and `FRAUD_SCORING` are separate FUTURE backlog ideas, excluded from this release.
`LOYALTY_POINTS` is cancelled entirely and is not a future commitment.

- `cart.mjs` exports `normalizeCart` and `priceOrder`.
- `summary.mjs` exports `formatSummary`; `summary.test.mjs` covers empty input, exact output shape, sums, zero totals, frozen inputs, repeated references and independent results.
- `receipt.mjs` exports `buildReceipt` and `renderCSV`; `receipt.test.mjs` covers exact shape, revised pricing, normalized units, defaults, immutable inputs and CSV escaping/order/CRLF separators without a trailing newline.
- `inventory.mjs` exports `reserveInventory`; its tests cover cross-price aggregation, atomic failure, missing/special keys and immutable inputs.
- `returns.mjs` exports `canReturn`; its tests cover ordered status/date/window checks and inclusive day 16 and rejection on day 17.
- `pipeline.mjs` exports both `fulfillOrder` and `returnOrder`; the two worker suites cover composition, pricing, failures and immutability.
- `integration.test.mjs` exercises all nine exports together: normalization, reservation, receipt, CSV, summary, day-14, day-15 and day-16 refunds and day-17 rejection, plus an atomic shortage.
- `cart.test.mjs` covers invalid lines, trimming, duplicate pairs, global first appearance, case sensitivity, zero prices, special SKU strings, fresh exact-shape outputs, frozen inputs, repeated references, and sparse arrays.
- Pricing tests cover defaults, exact output shape, coupon clamping and fractional percentages, rounding once per order, 7% tax after discount excluding shipping, normalized inputs and immutability.
- Existing `smoke.test.mjs` covers an empty cart and a valid line.
- Verification is configured as `unit` in `.dip/config.json`: `node --test` (also `npm test`). DIP verification and the latest checkpoint hold the actual check result.
- The earlier integration merge is complete; no active merge or unmerged paths remain. This final change creates no commits or branches.

## Fixed release policy

The revised policy below supersedes the earlier 10% tax rate, 15% coupon cap, tax on original subtotal and 30-day return window.
The final user change additionally supersedes USD, LF CSV separators and the inclusive 14-day return window with EUR, CRLF and 16 days inclusive. All adapters use the current contract below.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 7,
  "couponCapPercent": 20,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "EUR",
  "csvNewline": "CRLF",
  "returnWindowDays": 16,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Release contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep lines with a string SKU that is nonempty after trimming, a positive integer quantity, and a nonnegative integer unit price.
Drop invalid lines, including null, without coercion. Trim SKU and combine quantities only for the same trimmed SKU AND price.
Preserve global first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; never modify input.
The implementation uses nested maps keyed by SKU and price and a separate ordered result array.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`.
Subtotal sums normalized quantity times price. `couponPercent` defaults to 0 and is clamped to [0,20].
Round discount once: `Math.round(subtotalCents*couponPercent/100)`.
Tax base is subtotal AFTER the rounded discount, excluding shipping; round tax once: `Math.round((subtotalCents-discountCents)*7/100)`.
`shippingCents` defaults to 0 and is added after tax.
Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` takes `order={id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns exactly
`{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount:sumOfNormalizedQuantities,currency:'EUR'}`.
Use the implemented revised pricing directly, including 7% tax after discount with shipping excluded from the tax base.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency`, followed by rows in input order using CRLF record separators.
Fields containing comma, quote or newline use CSV quotes with embedded quotes doubled.
No trailing newline. Empty input returns just the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` takes an object of nonnegative integer stock counts by SKU; absent SKU means 0.
Aggregate normalized quantities across prices. Check ALL availability before subtracting anything.
