Build a local JavaScript library with the exports below. All operations must avoid
input mutation and return exactly the specified fields. Use Node.js built-ins;
no network or dependency installation. Work only in this repository. Do not
commit or create branches unless a later integration prompt explicitly permits
resolving an existing merge.

## Release policy

```json
{"taxRatePercent":11,"couponCapPercent":25,"taxBase":"after_discount_excluding_shipping","discountRounding":"once_per_order","currency":"GBP","csvNewline":"CRLF","returnWindowDays":23,"duplicatePolicy":"merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order","invalidPolicy":"drop","inventoryAtomic":true}
```

The final release update supersedes the earlier currency, CSV row separators and
return window: GBP, CRLF with no trailing newline and 23 days inclusive. The
revised 11% tax, 25% coupon cap and all other contracts remain in force. All
release adapters follow this policy.

MULTI_CURRENCY and FRAUD_SCORING are separate FUTURE ideas, outside this release.
LOYALTY_POINTS is CANCELLED and is not a future commitment.
Keep deferred features deferred and any cancelled features cancelled.

## Implementation sequence and contracts

1. **Completed: `normalizeCart(cart)` in `cart.mjs`.** Input is an array of
   lines. Keep only lines with a nonempty trimmed string sku, positive integer
   quantity, and nonnegative integer unitPriceCents; drop invalid lines including
   null. Trim sku. Merge quantities only for the same trimmed sku AND unit price,
   preserving each pair's first appearance. Return new objects containing exactly
   `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`. Never modify the input.
2. **Completed: `priceOrder(cart, options={})` in `cart.mjs`.** Normalize first;
   subtotal is the sum of quantity times unitPriceCents. couponPercent defaults
   to 0 and is clamped to [0,25]. Round the discount once with
   `Math.round(subtotal * couponPercent / 100)`. Tax base is subtotal minus the
   rounded discount, excluding shipping; round tax once with
   `Math.round(taxBase * 11 / 100)`.
   shippingCents defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Total is subtotal minus
   discount plus tax plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative
   integer shipping. Return exactly
   `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`.
3. **Completed: receipt exports in `receipt.mjs`.**
   `buildReceipt(order)` accepts `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns
   exactly `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`.
   itemCount sums normalized quantities; currency is GBP.
   `renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency` followed
   by rows in input order, using CRLF separators and no trailing newline. Quote
   fields containing comma, double quote or newline and double embedded quotes.
   Empty input returns only the header.
4. **Completed: `reserveInventory(stock,cart)` in `inventory.mjs`.** Stock contains
   nonnegative integer counts by sku; absent sku means 0. Aggregate normalized
   quantities across prices, check ALL availability first, and throw
   `RangeError('insufficient stock')` if any sku is insufficient. Otherwise return
   a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart,
   including on failure.
5. **Completed: `canReturn(order,{nowDay})` in `returns.mjs`.** Return exactly
   `{eligible,reason}`. Check in order: status equals `'delivered'`, else
   `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`; deliveredDay and nowDay are nonnegative
   integers with nowDay >= deliveredDay, else reason `'date'`; elapsed days are
   <= 23 (inclusive), else reason `'window'`. Success is `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.
6. **Completed: pipeline exports in `pipeline.mjs`.**
   `fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
   `{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

   `priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` when eligible, otherwise 0;
   currency is GBP. Preserve any other worker's exports when editing this module.
7. **Completed: `formatSummary(receipts)` in `summary.mjs`.** Return exactly
   `{orders:receipts.length,totalCents,units}`, summing receipt totalCents and
   itemCount respectively.

Integration is complete and both pipeline exports are retained. All nine exports
above are implemented. The final release update is implemented in receipt, CSV
and return adapters, their tests and the current handoff. Focused Node.js tests
cover contracts, policy boundaries, exact output shape and input immutability;
release.test.mjs also checks the adapters
together. Run `node --test` and `git diff --check` locally. Do not broaden the
release to future ideas.

See [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md) for the actual code state and latest validation.

# Local order-processing library

Build a local ES-module library without dependencies. All operations must leave
inputs unchanged and return exactly the specified fields. `normalizeCart`,
`priceOrder`, and `formatSummary` are implemented; all other exports remain pending for later
conversations. Do not add placeholder exports.

## Release policy

```json
{"taxRatePercent":17,"couponCapPercent":30,"taxBase":"after_discount_excluding_shipping","discountRounding":"once_per_order","currency":"USD","csvNewline":"LF","returnWindowDays":7,"duplicatePolicy":"merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order","invalidPolicy":"drop","inventoryAtomic":true}
```

This revised policy supersedes the earlier tax rate, coupon cap, tax base, and
return window. All pending adapters must follow this policy.

## Implementation sequence and contracts

1. **Implemented:** `normalizeCart(cart)` in `cart.mjs`. Accept an array of
   lines. Keep only lines with a nonempty trimmed string SKU, positive integer
   quantity, and nonnegative integer unit price in cents, dropping invalid lines
   including null. Trim SKU and merge quantities only for the same trimmed SKU
   and price, preserving first appearance. Return fresh objects with exactly
   `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`.
2. **Implemented:** `priceOrder(cart, options={})` in `cart.mjs`. Return exactly
   `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`. Subtotal is
   the sum of normalized quantity times price. Default coupon percent to 0 and
   clamp `options.couponPercent` to [0,30]; discount is
   `Math.round(subtotalCents*couponPercent/100)` once per order. Tax base is the
   subtotal after the rounded discount, excluding shipping; tax is
   `Math.round((subtotalCents-discountCents)*17/100)` once per order. Default
   `options.shippingCents` to 0 and add shipping after tax. Total is subtotal
   minus discount plus tax plus shipping.
   Assume finite numeric coupons and nonnegative integer shipping.
3. **Pending:** `buildReceipt(order)` in `receipt.mjs`, where order is
   `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}`. Return exactly
   `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`;
   itemCount sums normalized quantities and currency is USD.
4. **Pending:** `renderCSV(receipts)` in `receipt.mjs`. Header is
   `orderId,totalCents,currency`, followed by rows with those fields in order.
   Quote fields containing comma, double quote, or newline and double embedded
   quotes. Use LF row separators, no trailing newline; empty input yields only
   the header.
5. **Pending:** `reserveInventory(stock,cart)` in `inventory.mjs`. Stock contains
   nonnegative integer counts by SKU, with absent SKUs treated as 0. Aggregate
   normalized quantities across prices and check ALL availability first. If any
   SKU is insufficient, throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')`. Otherwise
   return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart,
   including on failure.
6. **Pending:** `canReturn(order,{nowDay})` in `returns.mjs`. Return exactly
   `{eligible,reason}`. Check in order: status must be `delivered` (otherwise
   false/status); deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers with
   nowDay >= deliveredDay (otherwise false/date); elapsed days must be <= 7
   (otherwise false/window). Success is `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.
7. **Pending:** `fulfillOrder(order,stock)` in `pipeline.mjs`. Return exactly
   `{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.
8. **Pending:** `returnOrder(order,context)` in `pipeline.mjs`. Return exactly
   `{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents,currency}`, with refund equal to
   `priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` when eligible and 0 otherwise;
   currency is USD. Preserve the other pipeline export when implementing either.
9. **Implemented:** `formatSummary(receipts)` in `summary.mjs`. Return exactly
   `{orders:receipts.length,totalCents,units}`, summing receipt totalCents and
   itemCount respectively.

Validate each implemented step with Node's built-in test runner, then add
cross-module checks as those modules become available.

## Deferred scope

MULTI_CURRENCY and FRAUD_SCORING are separate FUTURE ideas. Neither belongs to
this release; do not implement either as part of pending release work.

## Cancelled scope

LOYALTY_POINTS is cancelled entirely and is not a future commitment.

```json
{"taxRatePercent":17,"couponCapPercent":30,"taxBase":"after_discount_excluding_shipping","discountRounding":"once_per_order","currency":"USD","csvNewline":"LF","returnWindowDays":7,"duplicatePolicy":"merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order","invalidPolicy":"drop","inventoryAtomic":true}
```

return window. All release adapters follow this policy.

1. **Implemented:** `normalizeCart(cart)` in `cart.mjs`. Accept an array of
   lines. Keep only lines with a nonempty trimmed string SKU, positive integer

   including null. Trim SKU and merge quantities only for the same trimmed SKU
   and price, preserving first appearance. Return fresh objects with exactly
   `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`.
2. **Implemented:** `priceOrder(cart, options={})` in `cart.mjs`. Return exactly
   `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`. Subtotal is
   the sum of normalized quantity times price. Default coupon percent to 0 and
   clamp `options.couponPercent` to [0,30]; discount is
   `Math.round(subtotalCents*couponPercent/100)` once per order. Tax base is the
   subtotal after the rounded discount, excluding shipping; tax is
   `Math.round((subtotalCents-discountCents)*17/100)` once per order. Default
   `options.shippingCents` to 0 and add shipping after tax. Total is subtotal
   minus discount plus tax plus shipping.
   Assume finite numeric coupons and nonnegative integer shipping.
3. **Implemented:** `buildReceipt(order)` in `receipt.mjs`, where order is
   `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}`. Return exactly
   `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`;
   itemCount sums normalized quantities and currency is USD.
4. **Implemented:** `renderCSV(receipts)` in `receipt.mjs`. Header is
   `orderId,totalCents,currency`, followed by rows with those fields in order.

   quotes. Use LF row separators, no trailing newline; empty input yields only
   the header.
5. **Implemented:** `reserveInventory(stock,cart)` in `inventory.mjs`. Stock contains
   nonnegative integer counts by SKU, with absent SKUs treated as 0. Aggregate
   normalized quantities across prices and check ALL availability first. If any

   return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart,

# Worker A handoff

> Historical integration snapshot. Current code, final policy, and release
> verification are recorded in [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md) and [PLAN.md](PLAN.md).
> Values and pending-work statements below describe that earlier snapshot.

This is the current worker A code-state handoff. The original `HANDOFF.md`
predates the receipt checkpoint and incorrectly reports receipt/CSV as
unimplemented. `PLAN.md` remains the source of release contracts; its pending
labels for inventory and fulfillment are superseded by the implementation
state below. Shared plan and handoff files were left untouched to avoid
overlapping documentation edits with the other worker.

## Actual local code state

- `inventory.mjs` now exports `reserveInventory(stock, cart)`. It normalizes
  the cart, aggregates each SKU across prices using a Map, checks every
  requested quantity before producing any decremented stock, and returns a
  fresh stock object. Missing own SKU keys count as zero. Any shortage throws
  `RangeError('insufficient stock')`. Stock and cart remain unchanged on success
  and failure, including when frozen. Unrequested counts are retained.
- `pipeline.mjs` now exports `fulfillOrder(order, stock)` with exactly
  `{receipt: buildReceipt(order), stock: reserveInventory(stock, order.cart)}`.
  The receipt uses the existing revised pricing implementation. Inventory
  errors propagate without modifying order, options, cart, or stock.
- `normalizeCart`, `priceOrder`, `buildReceipt`, `renderCSV`, and
  `formatSummary` were already implemented and were left unchanged, together
  with their existing tests.
- `returns.mjs` remains its original comment-only placeholder in this
  worktree. No `canReturn` or `returnOrder` was implemented here. The original
  `pipeline.mjs` had no existing exports; its original preservation comment
  was retained and fulfillment was added below it.

## Ownership and integration

Worker A owns inventory, fulfillment, `inventory.test.mjs`,
`fulfillment.test.mjs`, `COORDINATION-A.md`, and this handoff. Ownership was
published through a Git blob at `refs/coordination/worker-a`; see
`COORDINATION-A.md`. No other coordination ref was present at the last check;
there is no acknowledgment from the other worker. No sibling worktree was
inspected. No commits or branches were created.

`pipeline.mjs` is the known overlapping file. When combining work, preserve
the `buildReceipt` and `reserveInventory` imports and `fulfillOrder` from this
worktree, along with every return-related import and export supplied by the
other worker. If Git reports an overlapping insertion at the original
comment, combine both additions rather than choosing either whole file.
Worker A has not merged, integrated, or verified the other worker's changes.
Run `node --test` and `git diff --check` after integration.

## Verification

`node --test` passed **29 tests, 0 failures**: 20 existing tests plus 6
inventory tests and 3 fulfillment tests. `git diff --check` passed.

Inventory checks cover trimming, duplicate quantities across prices, invalid
line dropping, free items, exact depletion, unchanged unrelated counts,
atomic shortage, missing/zero counts, prototype-name SKUs, null-prototype
stock, case sensitivity, empty/invalid-only carts, and independent outputs.
Fulfillment checks cover exact fields, immutable inputs, the 30% coupon cap,
17% tax after discount excluding shipping, defaults, shortages, repeated
calls, and consistent CSV/summary results.

## Remaining scope

Return eligibility and `returnOrder` remain outside worker A's scope; their
contracts are preserved in `PLAN.md` for the assigned worker. MULTI_CURRENCY
and FRAUD_SCORING stay deferred. LOYALTY_POINTS remains cancelled entirely.

The final user requirements supersede the previous currency, CSV row separators,
and return window: **CAD**, **CRLF without a trailing newline**, and **9 days

  SKU/price pairs in first appearance order into fresh objects. `priceOrder`

  subtotal at 17%, excludes shipping from tax, and adds shipping after tax.
- `receipt.mjs`: `buildReceipt` returns exactly the required receipt fields,
  normalized item counts, current pricing, and CAD currency. `renderCSV` selects
  the three required columns, quotes commas/quotes/newlines, doubles embedded
  quotes, and joins rows with CRLF without a trailing newline. Empty input

PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library

Build a local ES-module library without dependencies. All operations must leave
inputs unchanged and return exactly the specified fields. All nine release
exports below are implemented and integrated. Do not add placeholder exports.

## Release policy

```json
{"taxRatePercent":17,"couponCapPercent":30,"taxBase":"after_discount_excluding_shipping","discountRounding":"once_per_order","currency":"CAD","csvNewline":"CRLF","returnWindowDays":9,"duplicatePolicy":"merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order","invalidPolicy":"drop","inventoryAtomic":true}
```

The final release changes currency to CAD, CSV row separators to CRLF without
a trailing newline, and the return window to 9 days inclusive. These supersede
the earlier values. The revised 17% tax rate, 30% coupon cap, discounted tax
base excluding shipping, and all other release requirements remain in force.

## Implementation sequence and contracts

1. **Implemented:** `normalizeCart(cart)` in `cart.mjs`. Accept an array of
   lines. Keep only lines with a nonempty trimmed string SKU, positive integer
   quantity, and nonnegative integer unit price in cents, dropping invalid lines
   including null. Trim SKU and merge quantities only for the same trimmed SKU
   and price, preserving first appearance. Return fresh objects with exactly
   `{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`.
2. **Implemented:** `priceOrder(cart, options={})` in `cart.mjs`. Return exactly
   `{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`. Subtotal is
   the sum of normalized quantity times price. Default coupon percent to 0 and
   clamp `options.couponPercent` to [0,30]; discount is
   `Math.round(subtotalCents*couponPercent/100)` once per order. Tax base is the
   subtotal after the rounded discount, excluding shipping; tax is
   `Math.round((subtotalCents-discountCents)*17/100)` once per order. Default
   `options.shippingCents` to 0 and add shipping after tax. Total is subtotal
   minus discount plus tax plus shipping.
   Assume finite numeric coupons and nonnegative integer shipping.
3. **Implemented:** `buildReceipt(order)` in `receipt.mjs`, where order is
   `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}`. Return exactly
   `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`;
   itemCount sums normalized quantities and currency is CAD.
4. **Implemented:** `renderCSV(receipts)` in `receipt.mjs`. Header is
   `orderId,totalCents,currency`, followed by rows with those fields in order.
   Quote fields containing comma, double quote, or newline and double embedded
   quotes. Use CRLF row separators, no trailing newline; empty input yields only
   the header.
5. **Implemented:** `reserveInventory(stock,cart)` in `inventory.mjs`. Stock contains
   nonnegative integer counts by SKU, with absent SKUs treated as 0. Aggregate
   normalized quantities across prices and check ALL availability first. If any
   SKU is insufficient, throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')`. Otherwise
   return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart,
   including on failure.
6. **Implemented:** `canReturn(order,{nowDay})` in `returns.mjs`. Return exactly
   `{eligible,reason}`. Check in order: status must be `delivered` (otherwise
   false/status); deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers with
   nowDay >= deliveredDay (otherwise false/date); elapsed days must be <= 9
   (otherwise false/window). Success is `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.
7. **Implemented:** `fulfillOrder(order,stock)` in `pipeline.mjs`. Return exactly
   `{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.
8. **Implemented:** `returnOrder(order,context)` in `pipeline.mjs`. Return exactly
   `{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents,currency}`, with refund equal to
   `priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` when eligible and 0 otherwise;
   currency is CAD. Preserve the other pipeline export when implementing either.
9. **Implemented:** `formatSummary(receipts)` in `summary.mjs`. Return exactly
   `{orders:receipts.length,totalCents,units}`, summing receipt totalCents and
   itemCount respectively.

Validate each implemented step with Node's built-in test runner, then add
cross-module checks as those modules become available.

## Deferred scope

MULTI_CURRENCY and FRAUD_SCORING are separate FUTURE ideas. Neither belongs to
this release; do not implement either as part of pending release work.

## Cancelled scope

LOYALTY_POINTS is cancelled entirely and is not a future commitment.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library

## Scope and current handoff

This release implements the contracts below using local Node.js built-ins and no
dependencies. No input may be mutated anywhere, including on failure.

Only `normalizeCart` in `cart.mjs` is implemented in this conversation.
`cart.test.mjs` adds validation, grouping/order, special sku, exact output shape,
fresh-object and frozen-input tests; `smoke.test.mjs` contains the original tests.
All other exports below are pending; their module stubs remain unchanged.
There are no placeholder implementations for pending exports.

The current DIP task is
`task_de66476381aebc39ad41dad049c66d0eb149f488cc39252f0f85a9b08406ec67`.
The saved DIP plan and final checkpoint track this partial release. Configured
verification is DIP check `unit` (`node --test`); see its recorded evidence for
the actual result. No commits or branches are created in this conversation.

## Fixed release policy

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 10,
  "couponCapPercent": 15,
  "taxBase": "subtotal",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 30,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep only lines whose sku is a
string nonempty after trimming, quantity is a positive integer, and
unitPriceCents is a nonnegative integer. Drop invalid lines, including null.
Trim sku; combine quantities only for the same trimmed sku AND unit price.
Preserve first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly
`{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; leave the array and its lines untouched.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly
`{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`. Subtotal is the
sum of normalized quantity times unit price. couponPercent defaults to 0 and
is clamped to [0,15]. Discount is rounded once with
`Math.round(subtotalCents * couponPercent / 100)`. Tax is rounded once with
`Math.round(subtotalCents * 10 / 100)` (tax base is subtotal). shippingCents
defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax
plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` accepts `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns
exactly `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`.
itemCount is the sum of normalized quantities; currency is USD.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency` followed
by rows in that field order. Quote fields containing comma, quote or newline,
doubling embedded quotes. Use LF separators and no trailing newline. Empty
input returns only the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` accepts an object of nonnegative integer counts
by sku; absent sku means 0. Aggregate normalized quantities across all prices.
Check ALL sku availability first. Any shortage throws
`RangeError('insufficient stock')`; otherwise return a new stock object with
counts subtracted, preserving unrelated stock entries. Never mutate stock or
cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Check in order:

1. status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers and nowDay must be at
   least deliveredDay, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'date'}`.
3. nowDay minus deliveredDay must be <=30, otherwise
   `{eligible:false,reason:'window'}`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents,currency}`. refundCents is
`priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` if eligible, otherwise 0;
currency is USD.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sum of totalCents,units:sum of itemCount}`.

## Execution plan and pending tasks

1. Implement and verify normalization now (current task).
2. Implement pricing, atomic inventory and return eligibility in later
   conversations; eligibility can proceed independently of normalization.
3. Implement receipts and CSV after pricing; implement summary after receipts.
4. Implement both pipeline exports after their dependencies. Verify each step
   through the configured DIP check with contract and immutability tests.

| Pending work | DIP task | Dependencies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| priceOrder | task_d49e59a4-3137-46e3-bf77-777ec0793ecf | normalization |
| buildReceipt, renderCSV | task_866191dd-a741-4cd3-b491-08e4e3f813f1 | normalization, pricing |
| reserveInventory | task_9bb70c38-1e0e-4d44-877e-075b92f1a7f3 | normalization |
| canReturn | task_7e6f90ff-b495-4d53-818a-9d45e8a4b7e0 | none |
| fulfillOrder, returnOrder | task_24d5fceb-7dca-4c1a-8e89-f133bd72d333 | pricing, receipts, inventory, eligibility |
| formatSummary | task_45d90d1f-94ae-4d88-83f3-b9038077fcaa | receipts |

## Separate FUTURE ideas (backlog only)

- MULTI_CURRENCY: `task_9a089ba7-f246-425a-850e-05559e889fd6`.
- LOYALTY_POINTS: `task_76e0f348-f8ae-4b42-b728-0c688894dd82`.

Neither future idea is part of this release or authorized for implementation.
Keep them deferred; do not expand the fixed USD policy.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library

## Scope and current handoff

This release implements the contracts below using local Node.js built-ins and no
dependencies. No input may be mutated anywhere, including on failure.

`normalizeCart` and `priceOrder` in `cart.mjs` are implemented.
`cart.test.mjs` covers normalization and revised pricing, including coupon caps,
order-level rounding, tax after rounded discount excluding shipping, exact output
shape and frozen inputs; `smoke.test.mjs` contains the original tests.
All other exports below are pending; their module stubs remain unchanged.
There are no placeholder implementations for pending exports.

The current DIP task is
`task_42bfae588277ce1f64825a33f068fb56d52bf8c72795b2e56c4627112cf93d67`.
The saved DIP plan and final checkpoint track this partial release. Configured
verification is DIP check `unit` (`node --test`); see its recorded evidence for
the actual result. No commits or branches are created in this conversation.

## Fixed release policy

This revised policy supersedes the earlier 10% tax, 15% coupon cap, subtotal tax
base and 30-day return window. Pending adapters must use this contract.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 17,
  "couponCapPercent": 30,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 7,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep only lines whose sku is a
string nonempty after trimming, quantity is a positive integer, and
unitPriceCents is a nonnegative integer. Drop invalid lines, including null.
Trim sku; combine quantities only for the same trimmed sku AND unit price.
Preserve first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly
`{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; leave the array and its lines untouched.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly
`{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`. Subtotal is the
sum of normalized quantity times unit price. couponPercent defaults to 0 and
is clamped to [0,30]. Discount is rounded once per order with
`Math.round(subtotalCents * couponPercent / 100)`. Tax is rounded once with
`Math.round((subtotalCents - discountCents) * 17 / 100)`; the tax base uses the
rounded discount and excludes shipping. shippingCents
defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax
plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` accepts `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns
exactly `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`.
itemCount is the sum of normalized quantities; currency is USD.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency` followed
by rows in that field order. Quote fields containing comma, quote or newline,
doubling embedded quotes. Use LF separators and no trailing newline. Empty
input returns only the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` accepts an object of nonnegative integer counts
by sku; absent sku means 0. Aggregate normalized quantities across all prices.
Check ALL sku availability first. Any shortage throws
`RangeError('insufficient stock')`; otherwise return a new stock object with
counts subtracted, preserving unrelated stock entries. Never mutate stock or
cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Check in order:

1. status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers and nowDay must be at
   least deliveredDay, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'date'}`.
3. nowDay minus deliveredDay must be <=7 (day 7 is eligible), otherwise
   `{eligible:false,reason:'window'}`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents,currency}`. refundCents is
`priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` if eligible, otherwise 0;
currency is USD.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sum of totalCents,units:sum of itemCount}`.

## Execution plan and pending tasks

1. Normalization and revised pricing are implemented; verify with DIP `unit`.
2. Implement atomic inventory and return eligibility in later conversations;
   eligibility can proceed independently of normalization.
3. Implement receipts and CSV after pricing; implement summary after receipts.
4. Implement both pipeline exports after their dependencies. Verify each step
   through the configured DIP check with contract and immutability tests.

| Pending work | DIP task | Dependencies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| buildReceipt, renderCSV | task_866191dd-a741-4cd3-b491-08e4e3f813f1 | normalization, pricing |
| reserveInventory | task_9bb70c38-1e0e-4d44-877e-075b92f1a7f3 | normalization |
| canReturn | task_7e6f90ff-b495-4d53-818a-9d45e8a4b7e0 | none |
| fulfillOrder, returnOrder | task_24d5fceb-7dca-4c1a-8e89-f133bd72d333 | pricing, receipts, inventory, eligibility |
| formatSummary | task_45d90d1f-94ae-4d88-83f3-b9038077fcaa | receipts |

Pricing is tracked by the current task above. The earlier pricing backlog task
`task_d49e59a4-3137-46e3-bf77-777ec0793ecf` is superseded by this revised task;
receipt and pipeline pricing dependencies now point to the revised task.

## Separate FUTURE ideas (backlog only)

- MULTI_CURRENCY: `task_9a089ba7-f246-425a-850e-05559e889fd6`.
- LOYALTY_POINTS: `task_76e0f348-f8ae-4b42-b728-0c688894dd82`.

Neither future idea is part of this release or authorized for implementation.
Keep them deferred; do not expand the fixed USD policy.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library

## Scope and current handoff

This release implements the contracts below using local Node.js built-ins and no
dependencies. No input may be mutated anywhere, including on failure.

`normalizeCart` and `priceOrder` in `cart.mjs`, and `formatSummary` in
`summary.mjs`, are implemented.
`cart.test.mjs` covers normalization and revised pricing, including coupon caps,
order-level rounding, tax after rounded discount excluding shipping, exact output
shape and frozen inputs; `smoke.test.mjs` contains the original tests.
Summary counts supplied receipts and sums their totals and item counts without
mutation; it does not depend on the pending receipt adapter implementation.
All other exports below are pending; their module stubs remain unchanged.
There are no placeholder implementations for pending exports.

The current DIP task is
`task_f8cce34f3805c0b9a3c4c933baee315041221c4957f01aa841263be9302c914d`.
The saved DIP plan and final checkpoint track this partial release. Configured
verification is DIP check `unit` (`node --test`); see its recorded evidence for
the actual result. No commits or branches are created in this conversation.

## Fixed release policy

This revised policy supersedes the earlier 10% tax, 15% coupon cap, subtotal tax
base and 30-day return window. Pending adapters must use this contract.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 17,
  "couponCapPercent": 30,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 7,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep only lines whose sku is a
string nonempty after trimming, quantity is a positive integer, and
unitPriceCents is a nonnegative integer. Drop invalid lines, including null.
Trim sku; combine quantities only for the same trimmed sku AND unit price.
Preserve first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly
`{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; leave the array and its lines untouched.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly
`{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`. Subtotal is the
sum of normalized quantity times unit price. couponPercent defaults to 0 and
is clamped to [0,30]. Discount is rounded once per order with
`Math.round(subtotalCents * couponPercent / 100)`. Tax is rounded once with
`Math.round((subtotalCents - discountCents) * 17 / 100)`; the tax base uses the
rounded discount and excludes shipping. shippingCents
defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax
plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` accepts `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns
exactly `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`.
itemCount is the sum of normalized quantities; currency is USD.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency` followed
by rows in that field order. Quote fields containing comma, quote or newline,
doubling embedded quotes. Use LF separators and no trailing newline. Empty
input returns only the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` accepts an object of nonnegative integer counts
by sku; absent sku means 0. Aggregate normalized quantities across all prices.
Check ALL sku availability first. Any shortage throws
`RangeError('insufficient stock')`; otherwise return a new stock object with
counts subtracted, preserving unrelated stock entries. Never mutate stock or
cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Check in order:

1. status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers and nowDay must be at
   least deliveredDay, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'date'}`.
3. nowDay minus deliveredDay must be <=7 (day 7 is eligible), otherwise
   `{eligible:false,reason:'window'}`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents,currency}`. refundCents is
`priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` if eligible, otherwise 0;
currency is USD.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sum of totalCents,units:sum of itemCount}`.

## Execution plan and pending tasks

1. Normalization, revised pricing and summary are implemented; verify with DIP `unit`.
2. Implement atomic inventory and return eligibility in later conversations;
   eligibility can proceed independently of normalization.
3. Implement receipts and CSV after pricing in a later conversation.
4. Implement both pipeline exports after their dependencies. Verify each step
   through the configured DIP check with contract and immutability tests.

| Pending work | DIP task | Dependencies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| buildReceipt, renderCSV | task_866191dd-a741-4cd3-b491-08e4e3f813f1 | normalization, pricing |
| reserveInventory | task_9bb70c38-1e0e-4d44-877e-075b92f1a7f3 | normalization |
| canReturn | task_7e6f90ff-b495-4d53-818a-9d45e8a4b7e0 | none |
| fulfillOrder, returnOrder | task_24d5fceb-7dca-4c1a-8e89-f133bd72d333 | pricing, receipts, inventory, eligibility |

Pricing is tracked by
`task_42bfae588277ce1f64825a33f068fb56d52bf8c72795b2e56c4627112cf93d67`.
The earlier pricing backlog task
`task_d49e59a4-3137-46e3-bf77-777ec0793ecf` is superseded by this revised task;
receipt and pipeline pricing dependencies now point to the revised task.

Summary is tracked by the current task above. The earlier summary backlog task
`task_45d90d1f-94ae-4d88-83f3-b9038077fcaa` is superseded by this side task.
It can summarize supplied receipts independently; receipt, inventory, return
and pipeline implementations remain pending.

## Separate FUTURE ideas (backlog only)

- MULTI_CURRENCY: `task_9a089ba7-f246-425a-850e-05559e889fd6`.
- FRAUD_SCORING: `task_4854e15d-a482-4c56-9ac9-20fe3b50cfce`.

Neither future idea is part of this release or authorized for implementation.
Keep them deferred; do not expand the fixed USD policy.

LOYALTY_POINTS (`task_76e0f348-f8ae-4b42-b728-0c688894dd82`) is cancelled
entirely, not a future commitment. Do not implement it.

tasks.description:
Create a plan for this project and start it. Build a local order-processing library with these exports in the indicated modules. normalizeCart(cart) in cart.mjs: accept an array of lines; keep lines whose sku is a nonempty trimmed string, quantity is a positive integer, and unitPriceCents is a nonnegative integer. Trim sku; drop invalid lines, including null. Combine quantities only for the same trimmed sku AND unit price, preserving first appearance. Return new {sku,quantity,unitPriceCents} objects, without modifying input. priceOrder(cart, options={}) in cart.mjs returns exactly {subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}. subtotal is sum of normalized quantity*price. couponPercent defaults to 0; clamp it to [0,cap]. Round discount once with Math.round(subtotal*couponPercent/100). Round tax once with Math.round(taxBase*taxRate/100). shippingCents defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping. buildReceipt(order) in receipt.mjs uses order={id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}; return exactly {orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount:sum of normalized quantities,currency}. renderCSV(receipts) in receipt.mjs returns a header orderId,totalCents,currency followed by rows; escape fields containing comma, quote or newline using CSV quoting and doubled quotes; no trailing newline; empty input returns just the header. reserveInventory(stock,cart) in inventory.mjs: stock is an object of nonnegative integer counts by sku, absent sku means 0; aggregate normalized quantities across prices, check ALL availability first; throw RangeError('insufficient stock') if any sku is insufficient; otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart, even on failure. canReturn(order,{nowDay}) in returns.mjs returns exactly {eligible,reason}. Check in order: status must equal 'delivered' else reason 'status'; deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers with nowDay>=deliveredDay else reason 'date'; nowDay-deliveredDay must be <= returnWindowDays else reason 'window'; otherwise {eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}. fulfillOrder(order,stock) in pipeline.mjs returns exactly {receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}. returnOrder(order,context) in pipeline.mjs returns exactly {...canReturn(order,context),refundCents:eligible?priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents:0,currency}. formatSummary(receipts) in summary.mjs returns exactly {orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sum of totalCents,units:sum of itemCount}. No input mutation anywhere. The policy is {"taxRatePercent":10,"couponCapPercent":15,"taxBase":"subtotal","discountRounding":"once_per_order","currency":"USD","csvNewline":"LF","returnWindowDays":30,"duplicatePolicy":"merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order","invalidPolicy":"drop","inventoryAtomic":true}. MULTI_CURRENCY and LOYALTY_POINTS are separate FUTURE ideas, not part of this release.
Implement ONLY normalizeCart now; leave the other exports pending for other conversations. Preserve the project intent and the partial handoff using appropriate local mechanisms.
acceptance: Persist the full release contract and fixed policy; pending exports and separate FUTURE ideas remain unimplemented.
normalizeCart drops invalid lines, trims sku, merges only matching sku and unit price, and preserves first appearance.
Return fresh exact-shape objects without mutating inputs; configured unit checks pass.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library

## Scope and current handoff

This release implements the contracts below using local Node.js built-ins and no
dependencies. No input may be mutated anywhere, including on failure.

`normalizeCart` and `priceOrder` in `cart.mjs`, and `formatSummary` in
`summary.mjs`, are implemented.
`cart.test.mjs` covers normalization and revised pricing, including coupon caps,
order-level rounding, tax after rounded discount excluding shipping, exact output
shape and frozen inputs; `smoke.test.mjs` contains the original tests.
Summary counts supplied receipts and sums their totals and item counts without
mutation; it does not depend on the pending receipt adapter implementation.
All other exports below are pending; their module stubs remain unchanged.
There are no placeholder implementations for pending exports.

The current DIP task is
`task_f8cce34f3805c0b9a3c4c933baee315041221c4957f01aa841263be9302c914d`.
The saved DIP plan and final checkpoint track this partial release. Configured
verification is DIP check `unit` (`node --test`); see its recorded evidence for
the actual result. No commits or branches are created in this conversation.

## Fixed release policy

This revised policy supersedes the earlier 10% tax, 15% coupon cap, subtotal tax
base and 30-day return window. Pending adapters must use this contract.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 17,
  "couponCapPercent": 30,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 7,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep only lines whose sku is a
string nonempty after trimming, quantity is a positive integer, and
unitPriceCents is a nonnegative integer. Drop invalid lines, including null.
Trim sku; combine quantities only for the same trimmed sku AND unit price.
Preserve first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly
`{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; leave the array and its lines untouched.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly
`{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`. Subtotal is the
sum of normalized quantity times unit price. couponPercent defaults to 0 and
is clamped to [0,30]. Discount is rounded once per order with
`Math.round(subtotalCents * couponPercent / 100)`. Tax is rounded once with
`Math.round((subtotalCents - discountCents) * 17 / 100)`; the tax base uses the
rounded discount and excludes shipping. shippingCents
defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax
plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` accepts `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns
exactly `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`.
itemCount is the sum of normalized quantities; currency is USD.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency` followed
by rows in that field order. Quote fields containing comma, quote or newline,
doubling embedded quotes. Use LF separators and no trailing newline. Empty
input returns only the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` accepts an object of nonnegative integer counts
by sku; absent sku means 0. Aggregate normalized quantities across all prices.
Check ALL sku availability first. Any shortage throws
`RangeError('insufficient stock')`; otherwise return a new stock object with
counts subtracted, preserving unrelated stock entries. Never mutate stock or
cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Check in order:

1. status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers and nowDay must be at
   least deliveredDay, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'date'}`.
3. nowDay minus deliveredDay must be <=7 (day 7 is eligible), otherwise
   `{eligible:false,reason:'window'}`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents,currency}`. refundCents is
`priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` if eligible, otherwise 0;
currency is USD.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sum of totalCents,units:sum of itemCount}`.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library

## Scope and current handoff

This release implements the contracts below using local Node.js built-ins and no
dependencies. No input may be mutated anywhere, including on failure.

`normalizeCart` and `priceOrder` in `cart.mjs`, and `formatSummary` in
`summary.mjs`, are implemented.
`cart.test.mjs` covers normalization and revised pricing, including coupon caps,
order-level rounding, tax after rounded discount excluding shipping, exact output
shape and frozen inputs; `smoke.test.mjs` contains the original tests.
Summary counts supplied receipts and sums their totals and item counts without
mutation; it does not depend on the pending receipt adapter implementation.
All other exports below are pending; their module stubs remain unchanged.
There are no placeholder implementations for pending exports.

The current DIP task is
`task_f8cce34f3805c0b9a3c4c933baee315041221c4957f01aa841263be9302c914d`.
The saved DIP plan and final checkpoint track this partial release. Configured
verification is DIP check `unit` (`node --test`); see its recorded evidence for
the actual result. No commits or branches are created in this conversation.

## Fixed release policy

This revised policy supersedes the earlier 10% tax, 15% coupon cap, subtotal tax
base and 30-day return window. Pending adapters must use this contract.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 17,
  "couponCapPercent": 30,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 7,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep only lines whose sku is a
string nonempty after trimming, quantity is a positive integer, and
unitPriceCents is a nonnegative integer. Drop invalid lines, including null.
Trim sku; combine quantities only for the same trimmed sku AND unit price.
Preserve first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly
`{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; leave the array and its lines untouched.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly
`{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`. Subtotal is the
sum of normalized quantity times unit price. couponPercent defaults to 0 and
is clamped to [0,30]. Discount is rounded once per order with
`Math.round(subtotalCents * couponPercent / 100)`. Tax is rounded once with
`Math.round((subtotalCents - discountCents) * 17 / 100)`; the tax base uses the
rounded discount and excludes shipping. shippingCents
defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax
plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` accepts `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns
exactly `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`.
itemCount is the sum of normalized quantities; currency is USD.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency` followed
by rows in that field order. Quote fields containing comma, quote or newline,
doubling embedded quotes. Use LF separators and no trailing newline. Empty
input returns only the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` accepts an object of nonnegative integer counts
by sku; absent sku means 0. Aggregate normalized quantities across all prices.
Check ALL sku availability first. Any shortage throws
`RangeError('insufficient stock')`; otherwise return a new stock object with
counts subtracted, preserving unrelated stock entries. Never mutate stock or
cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Check in order:

1. status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers and nowDay must be at
   least deliveredDay, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'date'}`.
3. nowDay minus deliveredDay must be <=7 (day 7 is eligible), otherwise
   `{eligible:false,reason:'window'}`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents,currency}`. refundCents is
`priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` if eligible, otherwise 0;
currency is USD.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sum of totalCents,units:sum of itemCount}`.

## Execution plan and pending tasks

1. Normalization, revised pricing and summary are implemented; verify with DIP `unit`.
2. Implement atomic inventory and return eligibility in later conversations;
   eligibility can proceed independently of normalization.
3. Implement receipts and CSV after pricing in a later conversation.
4. Implement both pipeline exports after their dependencies. Verify each step
   through the configured DIP check with contract and immutability tests.

| Pending work | DIP task | Dependencies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| buildReceipt, renderCSV | task_866191dd-a741-4cd3-b491-08e4e3f813f1 | normalization, pricing |
| reserveInventory | task_9bb70c38-1e0e-4d44-877e-075b92f1a7f3 | normalization |
| canReturn | task_7e6f90ff-b495-4d53-818a-9d45e8a4b7e0 | none |
| fulfillOrder, returnOrder | task_24d5fceb-7dca-4c1a-8e89-f133bd72d333 | pricing, receipts, inventory, eligibility |

Pricing is tracked by
`task_42bfae588277ce1f64825a33f068fb56d52bf8c72795b2e56c4627112cf93d67`.
The earlier pricing backlog task
`task_d49e59a4-3137-46e3-bf77-777ec0793ecf` is superseded by this revised task;
receipt and pipeline pricing dependencies now point to the revised task.

Summary is tracked by the current task above. The earlier summary backlog task
`task_45d90d1f-94ae-4d88-83f3-b9038077fcaa` is superseded by this side task.
It can summarize supplied receipts independently; receipt, inventory, return
and pipeline implementations remain pending.

## Separate FUTURE ideas (backlog only)

- MULTI_CURRENCY: `task_9a089ba7-f246-425a-850e-05559e889fd6`.
- FRAUD_SCORING: `task_4854e15d-a482-4c56-9ac9-20fe3b50cfce`.

Neither future idea is part of this release or authorized for implementation.
Keep them deferred; do not expand the fixed USD policy.

LOYALTY_POINTS (`task_76e0f348-f8ae-4b42-b728-0c688894dd82`) is cancelled
entirely, not a future commitment. Do not implement it.

# Worker A handoff

Task: `task_7c51463cb95b2e139d67d23d8ccbe60edc40fb2a979a436af60afb9809098028`.
Worktree branch: `worker-a`. Changes are uncommitted for the harness to commit.

## Actual code state

- `inventory.mjs` exports `reserveInventory(stock, cart)`. It normalizes the
  cart, aggregates demand across prices by SKU, treats absent own stock as zero,
  checks all availability before producing a fresh stock object, and preserves
  unrelated counts. Shortages throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')` without
  mutating either input. Prototype-named SKUs are supported as ordinary keys.
- `pipeline.mjs` exports `fulfillOrder(order, stock)` with exactly `{receipt,
  stock}` using the existing `buildReceipt` and the new `reserveInventory`.
  Existing receipt pricing supplies the 30% coupon cap, order-level discount
  rounding, 17% tax after discount excluding shipping, and fixed USD currency.
- `inventory.test.mjs` and `fulfillment.test.mjs` add eight tests covering mixed
  prices, normalization, shortages and atomicity, frozen inputs, fresh results,
  special SKU keys, exact output shapes, default options and revised pricing.
- Normalization, pricing, receipt/CSV and summary were already implemented in
  this checkout. `returns.mjs` remains a stub; `returnOrder` is absent here.
  No existing pipeline export was removed (the starting file was only a comment).

inventory module, dedicated tests and this handoff. Other workers were observed
only through DIP coordination metadata; no other worktree was inspected.
Ownership is released at final handoff so shared pipeline work can proceed.

must coexist with any `canReturn`/`priceOrder` imports and `returnOrder`. Both
workers may add to the original one-comment pipeline file, so integration may
need to combine additions. Run DIP `unit` again after combining branches.

Its implementation status is stale (including its statement that receipts are
pending); the contracts remain the recovered policy. Integration should
reconcile the older inventory backlog task
`task_9bb70c38-1e0e-4d44-877e-075b92f1a7f3` with this verified implementation,
and the combined pipeline backlog task
`task_24d5fceb-7dca-4c1a-8e89-f133bd72d333` with the actual combined exports.
Do not mark the combined pipeline task complete based solely on Worker A.

## Verification and scope

Configured DIP check `unit` runs `node --test`: all 28 tests passed, including
the eight new inventory/fulfillment tests, with zero failures or skips.
`git diff --check` passed. Verification here covers this worktree, not the
eventual merged release; DIP stores the executed check's snapshot evidence.

Return eligibility and `returnOrder` were not implemented by Worker A.
MULTI_CURRENCY and FRAUD_SCORING remain deferred. LOYALTY_POINTS remains cancelled.
No network, dependencies, extra agents, commits or branches were used/created.

tasks.description:
Create a plan for this project and start it. Build a local order-processing library with these exports in the indicated modules. normalizeCart(cart) in cart.mjs: accept an array of lines; keep lines whose sku is a nonempty trimmed string, quantity is a positive integer, and unitPriceCents is a nonnegative integer. Trim sku; drop invalid lines, including null. Combine quantities only for the same trimmed sku AND unit price, preserving first appearance. Return new {sku,quantity,unitPriceCents} objects, without modifying input. priceOrder(cart, options={}) in cart.mjs returns exactly {subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}. subtotal is sum of normalized quantity*price. couponPercent defaults to 0; clamp it to [0,cap]. Round discount once with Math.round(subtotal*couponPercent/100). Round tax once with Math.round(taxBase*taxRate/100). shippingCents defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping. buildReceipt(order) in receipt.mjs uses order={id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}; return exactly {orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount:sum of normalized quantities,currency}. renderCSV(receipts) in receipt.mjs returns a header orderId,totalCents,currency followed by rows; escape fields containing comma, quote or newline using CSV quoting and doubled quotes; no trailing newline; empty input returns just the header. reserveInventory(stock,cart) in inventory.mjs: stock is an object of nonnegative integer counts by sku, absent sku means 0; aggregate normalized quantities across prices, check ALL availability first; throw RangeError('insufficient stock') if any sku is insufficient; otherwise return a new stock object with counts subtracted. Never modify stock or cart, even on failure. canReturn(order,{nowDay}) in returns.mjs returns exactly {eligible,reason}. Check in order: status must equal 'delivered' else reason 'status'; deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers with nowDay>=deliveredDay else reason 'date'; nowDay-deliveredDay must be <= returnWindowDays else reason 'window'; otherwise {eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}. fulfillOrder(order,stock) in pipeline.mjs returns exactly {receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}. returnOrder(order,context) in pipeline.mjs returns exactly {...canReturn(order,context),refundCents:eligible?priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents:0,currency}. formatSummary(receipts) in summary.mjs returns exactly {orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sum of totalCents,units:sum of itemCount}. No input mutation anywhere. The policy is {"taxRatePercent":10,"couponCapPercent":15,"taxBase":"subtotal","discountRounding":"once_per_order","currency":"USD","csvNewline":"LF","returnWindowDays":30,"duplicatePolicy":"merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order","invalidPolicy":"drop","inventoryAtomic":true}. MULTI_CURRENCY and LOYALTY_POINTS are separate FUTURE ideas, not part of this release.
Implement ONLY normalizeCart now; leave the other exports pending for other conversations. Preserve the project intent and the partial handoff using appropriate local mechanisms.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library

## Scope and current handoff

This release implements the contracts below using local Node.js built-ins and no
dependencies. No input may be mutated anywhere, including on failure.

`normalizeCart` and `priceOrder` in `cart.mjs`, and `formatSummary` in
`summary.mjs`, are implemented.
`cart.test.mjs` covers normalization and revised pricing, including coupon caps,
order-level rounding, tax after rounded discount excluding shipping, exact output
shape and frozen inputs; `smoke.test.mjs` contains the original tests.
Summary counts supplied receipts and sums their totals and item counts without
mutation; it does not depend on the pending receipt adapter implementation.
All other exports below are pending; their module stubs remain unchanged.
There are no placeholder implementations for pending exports.

The current DIP task is
`task_f8cce34f3805c0b9a3c4c933baee315041221c4957f01aa841263be9302c914d`.
The saved DIP plan and final checkpoint track this partial release. Configured
verification is DIP check `unit` (`node --test`); see its recorded evidence for
the actual result. No commits or branches are created in this conversation.

## Fixed release policy

This revised policy supersedes the earlier 10% tax, 15% coupon cap, subtotal tax
base and 30-day return window. Pending adapters must use this contract.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 17,
  "couponCapPercent": 30,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 7,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep only lines whose sku is a
string nonempty after trimming, quantity is a positive integer, and
unitPriceCents is a nonnegative integer. Drop invalid lines, including null.
Trim sku; combine quantities only for the same trimmed sku AND unit price.
Preserve first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly
`{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; leave the array and its lines untouched.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly
`{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`. Subtotal is the
sum of normalized quantity times unit price. couponPercent defaults to 0 and
is clamped to [0,30]. Discount is rounded once per order with
`Math.round(subtotalCents * couponPercent / 100)`. Tax is rounded once with
`Math.round((subtotalCents - discountCents) * 17 / 100)`; the tax base uses the
rounded discount and excludes shipping. shippingCents
defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax
plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` accepts `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns
exactly `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`.
itemCount is the sum of normalized quantities; currency is USD.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency` followed
by rows in that field order. Quote fields containing comma, quote or newline,
doubling embedded quotes. Use LF separators and no trailing newline. Empty
input returns only the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` accepts an object of nonnegative integer counts
by sku; absent sku means 0. Aggregate normalized quantities across all prices.
Check ALL sku availability first. Any shortage throws
`RangeError('insufficient stock')`; otherwise return a new stock object with
counts subtracted, preserving unrelated stock entries. Never mutate stock or
cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Check in order:

1. status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers and nowDay must be at
   least deliveredDay, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'date'}`.
3. nowDay minus deliveredDay must be <=7 (day 7 is eligible), otherwise
   `{eligible:false,reason:'window'}`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents,currency}`. refundCents is
`priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` if eligible, otherwise 0;
currency is USD.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sum of totalCents,units:sum of itemCount}`.

## Execution plan and pending tasks

1. Normalization, revised pricing and summary are implemented; verify with DIP `unit`.
2. Implement atomic inventory and return eligibility in later conversations;
   eligibility can proceed independently of normalization.
3. Implement receipts and CSV after pricing in a later conversation.
4. Implement both pipeline exports after their dependencies. Verify each step
   through the configured DIP check with contract and immutability tests.

| Pending work | DIP task | Dependencies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| buildReceipt, renderCSV | task_866191dd-a741-4cd3-b491-08e4e3f813f1 | normalization, pricing |
| reserveInventory | task_9bb70c38-1e0e-4d44-877e-075b92f1a7f3 | normalization |
| canReturn | task_7e6f90ff-b495-4d53-818a-9d45e8a4b7e0 | none |
| fulfillOrder, returnOrder | task_24d5fceb-7dca-4c1a-8e89-f133bd72d333 | pricing, receipts, inventory, eligibility |

Pricing is tracked by
`task_42bfae588277ce1f64825a33f068fb56d52bf8c72795b2e56c4627112cf93d67`.
The earlier pricing backlog task
`task_d49e59a4-3137-46e3-bf77-777ec0793ecf` is superseded by this revised task;
receipt and pipeline pricing dependencies now point to the revised task.

Summary is tracked by the current task above. The earlier summary backlog task
`task_45d90d1f-94ae-4d88-83f3-b9038077fcaa` is superseded by this side task.
It can summarize supplied receipts independently; receipt, inventory, return
and pipeline implementations remain pending.

## Separate FUTURE ideas (backlog only)

- MULTI_CURRENCY: `task_9a089ba7-f246-425a-850e-05559e889fd6`.
- FRAUD_SCORING: `task_4854e15d-a482-4c56-9ac9-20fe3b50cfce`.

Neither future idea is part of this release or authorized for implementation.
Keep them deferred; do not expand the fixed USD policy.

LOYALTY_POINTS (`task_76e0f348-f8ae-4b42-b728-0c688894dd82`) is cancelled
entirely, not a future commitment. Do not implement it.

# Local order-processing library

## Scope and current handoff

All nine current release exports are implemented and integrated:
normalizeCart, priceOrder, buildReceipt, renderCSV, reserveInventory, canReturn,
fulfillOrder, returnOrder and formatSummary. No input is mutated on success or
failure. Both worker pipeline functions and imports are retained.

The receipt adapter and its seven focused checks were present at integration;
inspection confirmed their exact shape, normalized units, revised pricing, USD
and CSV escaping requirements. Its interrupted work is completed by updating
this handoff and reconciling its task status. No receipt code repair was needed.

Worker A was already merged. Worker B's existing merge conflicted only in
pipeline.mjs; integration combines both functions, preserving both workers'
requested functionality. MERGE_HANDOFF.md and worker handoffs record their
historical states; this document and handoff.json describe the integrated release.

Verification uses configured DIP check unit (node --test). The merged suite has
39 tests covering all modules, including a fulfillment-to-CSV/summary/return
scenario and frozen summary inputs. Configured DIP unit verification passed
with 39 tests, zero failures and no code changes during the check. Both staged
and unstaged Git diff --check passed before committing the merge resolution.
handoff.json records the recovered contract,
implemented export names, deferred/cancelled identifiers and release readiness.

Current integration task:
task_a7f819ca08acbaa8fb51f49ab3f80d0c1337d01fed7df4b30c0c9606d27e2c1d.

## Fixed release policy

This revised policy supersedes the earlier 10% tax, 15% coupon cap, subtotal tax
base and 30-day return window. All release adapters use this contract.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 17,
  "couponCapPercent": 30,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "USD",
  "csvNewline": "LF",
  "returnWindowDays": 7,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep only lines whose sku is a
string nonempty after trimming, quantity is a positive integer, and
unitPriceCents is a nonnegative integer. Drop invalid lines, including null.
Trim sku; combine quantities only for the same trimmed sku AND unit price.
Preserve first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly
`{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; leave the array and its lines untouched.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly
`{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`. Subtotal is the
sum of normalized quantity times unit price. couponPercent defaults to 0 and
is clamped to [0,30]. Discount is rounded once per order with
`Math.round(subtotalCents * couponPercent / 100)`. Tax is rounded once with
`Math.round((subtotalCents - discountCents) * 17 / 100)`; the tax base uses the
rounded discount and excludes shipping. shippingCents
defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax
plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` accepts `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns
exactly `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`.
itemCount is the sum of normalized quantities; currency is USD.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency` followed
by rows in that field order. Quote fields containing comma, quote or newline,
doubling embedded quotes. Use LF separators and no trailing newline. Empty
input returns only the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` accepts an object of nonnegative integer counts
by sku; absent sku means 0. Aggregate normalized quantities across all prices.
Check ALL sku availability first. Any shortage throws
`RangeError('insufficient stock')`; otherwise return a new stock object with
counts subtracted, preserving unrelated stock entries. Never mutate stock or
cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Check in order:

1. status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers and nowDay must be at
   least deliveredDay, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'date'}`.
3. nowDay minus deliveredDay must be <=7 (day 7 is eligible), otherwise
   `{eligible:false,reason:'window'}`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents,currency}`. refundCents is
`priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` if eligible, otherwise 0;
currency is USD.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sum of totalCents,units:sum of itemCount}`.

## Completed release work and task reconciliation

There are no remaining current release requirements after local verification.
The older release backlog entries are superseded by their actual implementation
and integration tasks; this does not change the deferred/cancelled feature scope.

PROJECT_PLAN.md.text:
# Local order-processing library

## Scope and current handoff

All nine current release exports are implemented and integrated:
normalizeCart, priceOrder, buildReceipt, renderCSV, reserveInventory, canReturn,
fulfillOrder, returnOrder and formatSummary. No input is mutated on success or
failure. Both worker pipeline functions and imports are retained.

The final release update is implemented: receipts and all refund outcomes use
CAD, CSV records use CRLF with no trailing newline, and returns are eligible
through day 9 inclusive (day 10 is outside the window). CSV quoting preserves
embedded CR, LF and CRLF field contents. All other release policies remain in
force, including pricing, exact output shapes and input immutability.

Worker A was already merged. Worker B's existing merge conflicted only in
pipeline.mjs; integration combines both functions, preserving both workers'
requested functionality. MERGE_HANDOFF.md and worker handoffs record their
historical states; this document and handoff.json describe the integrated release.

Verification uses configured DIP check unit (node --test). The final suite has
39 tests covering all modules, including a fulfillment-to-CSV/summary/return
scenario and frozen summary inputs. The updated checks cover fixed CAD,
CRLF record separators without a trailing newline, CSV escaping, days 7/8/9
remaining eligible, day 10 rejection, and status/date validation priority.
Whole-project verification passed with 39 tests, zero failures and no skips.
Git diff --check passed. Final release changes remain uncommitted; no branch
was created for this update.
handoff.json records the recovered contract,
implemented export names, deferred/cancelled identifiers and release readiness.

Current final release task:
task_e2f947f73d12a2214b26f7dc90b116cfe41c52f24f1c7e2080460479c6853c77.

## Fixed release policy

This final policy supersedes the intermediate USD currency, LF CSV separators
and 7-day return window, as well as the earlier 10% tax, 15% coupon cap,
subtotal tax base and 30-day return window. All release adapters use this contract.

```json
{
  "taxRatePercent": 17,
  "couponCapPercent": 30,
  "taxBase": "after_discount_excluding_shipping",
  "discountRounding": "once_per_order",
  "currency": "CAD",
  "csvNewline": "CRLF",
  "returnWindowDays": 9,
  "duplicatePolicy": "merge_same_sku_and_price_in_first_order",
  "invalidPolicy": "drop",
  "inventoryAtomic": true
}
```

## Contracts

### cart.mjs

`normalizeCart(cart)` accepts an array of lines. Keep only lines whose sku is a
string nonempty after trimming, quantity is a positive integer, and
unitPriceCents is a nonnegative integer. Drop invalid lines, including null.
Trim sku; combine quantities only for the same trimmed sku AND unit price.
Preserve first appearance of each pair. Return fresh objects with exactly
`{sku,quantity,unitPriceCents}`; leave the array and its lines untouched.

`priceOrder(cart, options={})` returns exactly
`{subtotalCents,discountCents,taxCents,shippingCents,totalCents}`. Subtotal is the
sum of normalized quantity times unit price. couponPercent defaults to 0 and
is clamped to [0,30]. Discount is rounded once per order with
`Math.round(subtotalCents * couponPercent / 100)`. Tax is rounded once with
`Math.round((subtotalCents - discountCents) * 17 / 100)`; the tax base uses the
rounded discount and excludes shipping. shippingCents
defaults to 0 and is added after tax. Total is subtotal minus discount plus tax
plus shipping. Assume finite numeric coupon and nonnegative integer shipping.

### receipt.mjs

`buildReceipt(order)` accepts `{id,cart,options,status,deliveredDay}` and returns
exactly `{orderId:order.id,...priceOrder(order.cart,order.options),itemCount,currency}`.
itemCount is the sum of normalized quantities; currency is CAD.

`renderCSV(receipts)` returns the header `orderId,totalCents,currency` followed
by rows in that field order. Quote fields containing comma, quote or newline,
doubling embedded quotes. Use CRLF record separators and no trailing newline.
Preserve newline characters inside quoted fields. Empty input returns only the header.

### inventory.mjs

`reserveInventory(stock,cart)` accepts an object of nonnegative integer counts
by sku; absent sku means 0. Aggregate normalized quantities across all prices.
Check ALL sku availability first. Any shortage throws
`RangeError('insufficient stock')`; otherwise return a new stock object with
counts subtracted, preserving unrelated stock entries. Never mutate stock or
cart, including on failure.

### returns.mjs

`canReturn(order,{nowDay})` returns exactly `{eligible,reason}`. Check in order:

1. status must equal `'delivered'`, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'status'}`.
2. deliveredDay and nowDay must be nonnegative integers and nowDay must be at
   least deliveredDay, otherwise `{eligible:false,reason:'date'}`.
3. nowDay minus deliveredDay must be <=9 (day 9 is eligible), otherwise
   `{eligible:false,reason:'window'}`.
4. Otherwise return `{eligible:true,reason:'eligible'}`.

### pipeline.mjs

`fulfillOrder(order,stock)` returns exactly
`{receipt:buildReceipt(order),stock:reserveInventory(stock,order.cart)}`.

`returnOrder(order,context)` returns exactly
`{...canReturn(order,context),refundCents,currency}`. refundCents is
`priceOrder(order.cart,order.options).totalCents` if eligible, otherwise 0;
currency is CAD.

### summary.mjs

`formatSummary(receipts)` returns exactly
`{orders:receipts.length,totalCents:sum of totalCents,units:sum of itemCount}`.

## Completed release work and task reconciliation

There are no remaining current release requirements after local verification.
The older release backlog entries are superseded by their actual implementation
and integration tasks; this does not change the deferred/cancelled feature scope.

| Implemented work | Implementation task |
| --- | --- |
| normalizeCart | task_de66476381aebc39ad41dad049c66d0eb149f488cc39252f0f85a9b08406ec67 |
| priceOrder | task_42bfae588277ce1f64825a33f068fb56d52bf8c72795b2e56c4627112cf93d67 |
| buildReceipt, renderCSV | task_89e9c543b1d9a70adf461cf4bfc93a113c2d827ccff8cc48df256b8d0211ea09 |
| reserveInventory, fulfillOrder | task_7c51463cb95b2e139d67d23d8ccbe60edc40fb2a979a436af60afb9809098028 |
| canReturn, returnOrder | task_764551d58a7bf6600cc7c79a7e0f1a87266a627ba52b17fdc973ca7a51b65a4e |
| formatSummary | task_f8cce34f3805c0b9a3c4c933baee315041221c4957f01aa841263be9302c914d |
| Combined release and handoff | task_a7f819ca08acbaa8fb51f49ab3f80d0c1337d01fed7df4b30c0c9606d27e2c1d |
| Final CAD, CRLF and 9-day policy update | task_e2f947f73d12a2214b26f7dc90b116cfe41c52f24f1c7e2080460479c6853c77 |

The original receipt, inventory and combined pipeline backlog tasks are
superseded. Pipeline dependency records now reference the actual receipt and
worker implementation tasks. Earlier pricing, summary and return backlog tasks
remain superseded. Future features below remain outside this release.

## Separate FUTURE ideas (backlog only)

- MULTI_CURRENCY: `task_9a089ba7-f246-425a-850e-05559e889fd6`.
- FRAUD_SCORING: `task_4854e15d-a482-4c56-9ac9-20fe3b50cfce`.

Neither future idea is part of this release or authorized for implementation.
Keep them deferred; do not expand the fixed CAD policy.

## Actual code state

  unrelated counts. Shortages throw `RangeError('insufficient stock')` without

  rounding, 17% tax after discount excluding shipping, and fixed USD currency.
- `inventory.test.mjs` and `fulfillment.test.mjs` add eight tests covering mixed
  prices, normalization, shortages and atomicity, frozen inputs, fresh results,
  special SKU keys, exact output shapes, default options and revised pricing.

  this checkout. `returns.mjs` remains a stub; `returnOrder` is absent here.

workers may add to the original one-comment pipeline file, so integration may

and the combined pipeline backlog task
`task_24d5fceb-7dca-4c1a-8e89-f133bd72d333` with the actual combined exports.
Do not mark the combined pipeline task complete based solely on Worker A.

## Verification and scope
